                position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 50%;
                transform: translateY(-50%);
                background: none; border: none; padding: 6px;
                color: var(--color-primary); cursor: pointer;
                align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .inline-search .scan-btn svg {
                position: static; transform: none;
                width: 18px; height: 18px; color: inherit;
            }

            /* Multi-select triggers collapse to 36×36 round icon buttons. */
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .ms-container.inline:not(#cust-ms):not(#despatchLg-ms) {
                flex: 0 0 auto;
                width: auto; max-width: none; min-width: 0;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .ms-container.inline:not(#cust-ms):not(#despatchLg-ms) .ms-trigger {
                width: 36px; height: 36px;
                min-width: 36px; min-height: 36px;
                padding: 0;
                border-radius: 999px;
                background: var(--hover-bg);
                white-space: nowrap;
                position: relative;
                display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
                color: var(--muted);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .ms-container.inline:not(#cust-ms):not(#despatchLg-ms) .ms-trigger .ms-icon { display: block; }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .ms-container.inline:not(#cust-ms):not(#despatchLg-ms) .ms-trigger .ms-active-dot { display: block; }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .ms-container.inline:not(#cust-ms):not(#despatchLg-ms) .ms-trigger .ms-field-label,
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .ms-container.inline:not(#cust-ms):not(#despatchLg-ms) .ms-trigger .ms-placeholder,
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .ms-container.inline:not(#cust-ms):not(#despatchLg-ms) .ms-trigger .ms-tag,
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip .ms-container.inline:not(#cust-ms):not(#despatchLg-ms) .ms-trigger > span[style*="margin-left:auto"] {
                display: none !important;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip > div[style*="margin-left:auto"] {
                flex: 0 0 auto;
                margin-left: 0 !important;
                gap: 6px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip > div[style*="margin-left:auto"] .hdr-btn {
                min-height: 36px;
                border-radius: 999px;
                padding: 6px 10px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #sortBySelect {
                min-height: 36px;
                border-radius: 999px;
                padding: 4px 8px;
                background: var(--hover-bg);
                font-size: 11px;
                max-width: 130px;
            }

            /* ── Orders toolbar, touch affordances (tablets too) ──
               Same story as the chip strip above: these were phone-only,
               so a tablet rendered shrunken desktop selects that wrapped.
               The full-screen customer sheet stays in the phone block — a
               tablet has room for the normal anchored dropdown. */
            /* Two rows, both nowrap. The filter row collapses to icon-only
               pills so five controls fit inside 390px without the refresh
               button falling off the end. */
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar { padding: 8px 10px; gap: 6px; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .ot-row { gap: 6px; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .inline-search { max-width: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .inline-search input {
                height: 38px; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 10px;
                background: var(--hover-bg);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .inline-search input:focus { background: #fff; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .hdr-btn { min-height: 38px; }

            /* Every filter collapses to a square icon button — no labels, no
               shrunken selects. Tapping opens #ordersMenu with full-size
               rows. The customer picker keeps its text, because WHICH
               customer is the one thing an icon cannot say. */
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .ot-pill {
                padding: 0; width: 38px; min-width: 38px; height: 38px;
                justify-content: center; flex: 0 0 auto;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .ot-pill .lbl { display: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .ot-pill svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersCustHost { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersCustHost .ms-trigger {
                height: 38px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--hover-bg);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersMenu .om-item { padding: 12px 12px; font-size: 14px; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersCustHost .ms-item { padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 14px; }
        }

        /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
           PHONE (< 640px) — TIER 2 LAYOUT
           Repositions the page around mobile-first interaction
           patterns: search-first, single-column cards with one
           dominant action per row, sticky cart bar, full-screen
           cart sheet, swipe-to-delete. All rules below are scoped
           to phones; tablet portrait (<1024px) keeps the simpler
           Tier 1 layout from the block above.
           ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        /* Phones — portrait <=639px OR landscape <=932px wide.
           Includes every iPhone in any orientation; excludes tablets
           (iPad portrait is 768px but reports orientation:portrait —
           gets Tier 1 instead). */
        @media (max-width: 639px),
               (max-width: 932px) and (orientation: landscape) {
            /* All rules below are scoped under `body.mobile-enabled`.
               Fishbowl-host mode (MODE='fishbowl', no body class)
               bypasses this entire block and renders the desktop
               layout regardless of viewport width. */

            body.mobile-enabled #pageSizeSelect,
            body.mobile-enabled #helpToggleBtn,
            body.mobile-enabled #refreshBtn,
            body.mobile-enabled #settingsToggleBtn {
                display: none !important;
            }

            /* List + List+Img views cannot fit a phone at any column width,
               so the view-mode toggle goes away entirely and setViewMode
               coerces to tile. Phone-only — see the note in Tier 1. */
            body.mobile-enabled .btn-group { display: none !important; }
            body.mobile-enabled header {
                padding: 0 12px;
                height: 52px;
                min-height: 52px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled header .hdr-title-block { display: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled #mobileCustomerTrigger    { display: inline-flex; }
            body.mobile-enabled header > div:first-child { gap: 8px; }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms > .ms-trigger { display: none !important; }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #despatchLg-ms        { display: none !important; }


            /* Customer dropdown — full-screen picker. */
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms .ms-dropdown {
                position: fixed !important;
                top: 0 !important; left: 0 !important; right: 0; bottom: 0;
                min-width: 0; max-width: none;
                width: 100vw; height: 100vh; height: 100dvh;
                max-height: none;
                border-radius: 0;
                box-shadow: none;
                z-index: 10500;
                display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms .ms-dropdown.hidden { display: none !important; }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms .ms-search {
                padding: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 12px) 12px 10px;
                background: white;
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
                gap: 8px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms .ms-search input {
                height: 40px; font-size: 14px;
                padding: 0 12px;
                border-radius: 10px;
                background: var(--hover-bg);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms .ms-dropdown .ms-back-btn {
                display: inline-flex;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms .ms-list { font-size: 14px; }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms .ms-item { padding: 14px 16px; }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #cust-ms .ms-item .sub { font-size: 12px; }

            /* Tree + Stock LG dropdowns — non-modal panels anchored
               below the filter strip. */
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #tree-ms,
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #lg-ms {
                position: static;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #tree-ms .ms-dropdown,
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #lg-ms .ms-dropdown {
                left: 12px;
                right: 12px;
                top: calc(100% + 4px);
                min-width: 0; max-width: none;
                width: auto;
                max-height: 60vh;
            }
            /* Back-arrow shown on tree/LG dropdowns too — when the
               dropdown panel covers most of the viewport, the user
               otherwise has nowhere to tap-outside to close. */
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #tree-ms .ms-back-btn,
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #lg-ms .ms-back-btn {
                display: inline-flex;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #tree-ms .ms-search,
            body.mobile-enabled #filterChipStrip #lg-ms .ms-search {
                gap: 8px;
            }

            /* Larger touch targets. */
            body.mobile-enabled .hdr-btn { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 14px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .hdr-btn-icon { padding: 10px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .qty-stepper button { min-width: 36px; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 15px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .qty-stepper input { min-height: 36px; width: 48px; font-size: 14px; }

            /* Single-column product cards. */
            body.mobile-enabled .tile-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 8px;
                padding: 0;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #productArea { padding: 12px 12px 96px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile {
                flex-direction: row;
                align-items: center;
                padding: 10px;
                gap: 12px;
                border-radius: 12px;
                box-shadow: none;
                background: white;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile:hover { box-shadow: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile:active { background: #f8fafc; }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .img-wrap {
                width: 64px; height: 64px;
                flex-shrink: 0;
                border-radius: 8px;
                border: none;
                background: var(--hover-bg);
                overflow: hidden;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .img-wrap .fav-group {
                top: 2px; right: 2px;
                padding: 1px 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .img-wrap .fav-group .fav-btn { padding: 1px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .img-wrap .fav-group .fav-btn svg {
                width: 12px; height: 12px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .body {
                padding: 0; gap: 2px; min-width: 0;
                flex: 1;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .num-pill {
                font-size: 10px;
                background: transparent; color: var(--muted-2);
                padding: 0;
                text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
                font-weight: 700;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .name {
                font-size: 13px;
                -webkit-line-clamp: 2; line-clamp: 2;
                font-weight: 600;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .last-purchase { display: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .price-row {
                padding-top: 2px; margin-top: 0;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .price { font-size: 15px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .uom { font-size: 10px; }
            /* Vertical qty stepper on the product tile. + on top, qty
               input in middle, − on bottom. Takes the full height of
               the tile so it's a big tap target. Replaces the
               desktop "round + button" pattern. */
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions {
                flex-direction: column;
                padding: 0;
                gap: 0;
                border-left: none;
                align-self: stretch;
                justify-content: stretch;
            }
            /* Hide the "Add" button — +/- modify the cart directly. */
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions .hdr-btn {
                display: none !important;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions .qty-stepper {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column-reverse;   /* + on top, − on bottom */
                width: 48px;
                align-self: stretch;
                border: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
                border-radius: 10px;
                overflow: hidden;
                background: white;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions .qty-stepper button {
                width: 100%;
                flex: 1;
                min-height: 30px;
                min-width: 0;
                padding: 0;
                background: var(--color-primary);
                color: white;
                border: none;
                font-size: 22px;
                font-weight: 600;
                line-height: 1;
                cursor: pointer;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions .qty-stepper button:active {
                background: var(--color-primary-dark);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions .qty-stepper input {
                width: 100%;
                min-height: 28px;
                padding: 2px 0;
                text-align: center;
                border: none;
                border-top: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
                font-size: 14px;
                font-weight: 700;
                background: white;
                color: #0f172a;
                outline: none;
                font-family: inherit;
                -moz-appearance: textfield;
                appearance: textfield;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions .qty-stepper input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions .qty-stepper input::-webkit-inner-spin-button {
                -webkit-appearance: none;
                margin: 0;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .product-tile .actions .qty-stepper input:focus {
                background: var(--tint-bg);
            }

            /* Cart sheet — full-screen, slides up. */
            body.mobile-enabled #cartPanel {
                width: 100vw; max-width: 100vw;
                transform: translateY(100%);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled.cart-drawer-open #cartPanel { transform: translateY(0); }
            body.mobile-enabled #cartPanel .cart-header {
                padding: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 12px) 16px 12px;
                font-size: 16px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #cartDrawerClose { padding: 8px; }
            body.mobile-enabled #cartDrawerClose svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }

            /* Address pickers. */
            body.mobile-enabled #addressPickers {
                padding: 10px 16px !important;
                background: var(--hover-bg);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #addressPickers label {
                padding: 12px 0;
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #addressPickers label:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled #addressPickers select {
                flex: 1; min-height: 40px;
                font-size: 13px;
                background: white;
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 6px 10px;
            }

            body.mobile-enabled #cartPanel .cart-list { padding: 12px 12px 0; }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line {
                position: relative;
                gap: 10px;
                padding: 10px;
                background: white;
                border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
                border-radius: 10px;
                margin-bottom: 6px;
                touch-action: pan-y;
                transition: background 0.15s;
                will-change: transform;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .drag-handle { display: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .info { padding-right: 0; }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .num {
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .sub-row {
                margin-top: 6px;
                gap: 8px;
                flex-wrap: wrap;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .price-input { width: 70px; font-size: 12px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .line-total-wrap { gap: 4px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .line-total { font-size: 14px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .tax-pill { font-size: 9px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line .remove-btn { display: none; }

            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line.swiping {
                background: #fef2f2;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line::after {
                content: '✕  Delete';
                position: absolute; top: 0; right: 16px; bottom: 0;
                display: flex; align-items: center;
                color: #b91c1c; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px;
                opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
                transition: opacity 0.1s;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .cart-line.swiping::after { opacity: 1; }

            body.mobile-enabled #cartPanel .cart-totals {
                padding: 14px 16px;
                background: var(--hover-bg);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #cartPanel .total-row.grand { font-size: 16px; }
            /* (cart-actions block removed — the element doesn't exist
               in the current HTML; CSO + Clear-cart live in cart-header
               and the catalogue's sticky bottom bar is the prominent
               action.) */
            /* CSO + Clear-cart buttons stay matched-height icon
               buttons in the cart header — both inherit the base
               `body.mobile-enabled .hdr-btn-icon` styling (40px).
               No special overrides; the prominent action is the
               sticky cart bar at the bottom of the catalogue, not
               here. */

            /* ── Orders view, phone ──────────────────────────────────
               The view switch is the ONLY way back to the catalogue, so
               unlike the other header controls it is never hidden — it
               just drops its labels and keeps a 40px touch target. */
            body.mobile-enabled .view-switch .hdr-btn .lbl { display: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled .view-switch .hdr-btn { padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 40px; }

            /* Full-screen customer list, matching the catalogue's treatment.
               The rules for that one are scoped to #filterChipStrip, which no
               longer contains this element once it has been relocated. */
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersCustHost .ms-dropdown {
                position: fixed !important;
                top: 0 !important; left: 0 !important; right: 0; bottom: 0;
                width: 100vw; height: 100vh; height: 100dvh;
                min-width: 0; max-width: none; max-height: none;
                border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; z-index: 10500;
                display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersCustHost .ms-dropdown.hidden { display: none !important; }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersCustHost .ms-search {
                padding: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 12px) 12px 10px;
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); gap: 8px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersCustHost .ms-search input {
                height: 40px; font-size: 14px; padding: 0 12px;
                border-radius: 10px; background: var(--hover-bg);
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersCustHost .ms-back-btn { display: inline-flex; }
            /* Bigger option rows in the filter popover. */
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersScroll { padding: 10px; }
            /* The status summary is its own line under the search row. */
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersStatusLine {
                flex: 1 1 100%; order: 3; font-size: 10.5px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled #ordersToolbar .ot-search-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }

            /* Line items: the 7-column grid cannot hold on a phone, so each
               line becomes a two-row block — identity above, figures below. */
            /* Two rows on a phone:
                 #  PRODNUM   description……
                    Ord/Pick/Ful          total
               The description sits beside the product number and takes only
               the leftover width of its own track, so it truncates instead of
               pushing into — or wrapping above — the total in the next
               column. Column 2 is shared by the product number and the qty
               figures, so it sizes to whichever is wider and the description
               gets the remainder. */
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line {
                grid-template-columns: 26px auto minmax(0, 1fr);
                grid-template-areas: "n prod desc" ". qty total";
                row-gap: 2px; column-gap: 8px; padding: 7px 4px;
            }
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line .sd-c-n     { grid-area: n; }
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line .sd-c-prod  { grid-area: prod; }
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line .sd-c-qty   { grid-area: qty; text-align: left; }
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line .sd-c-total { grid-area: total; }
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line .sd-c-desc  {
                grid-area: desc; min-width: 0;
                overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
                font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted-2);
            }
            /* The header row is hidden on a phone, so "5 / 2 / 0" had nothing
               naming it. Reveal the per-figure labels instead. */
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line .qty-lbl { display: inline; }
            /* Unit price and per-line status still fold away — the total is
               the figure that matters, and status is on the order header. */
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line .sd-c-price,
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line .sd-c-status { display: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled .sd-line.sd-line-head { display: none; }
            body.mobile-enabled .so-detail { padding: 10px 12px; border-left-width: 3px; }
            body.mobile-enabled .so-detail .sd-kv { gap: 3px 14px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-50">

<!-- Toast container -->
<div class="toast-container"></div>

<!-- Confirmation modal — populated + shown by showConfirm(). -->
<div id="qoConfirmModal" class="qo-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="qoConfirmTitle">
    <div class="qo-modal-backdrop"></div>
    <div class="qo-modal-card">
        <div class="modal-head" id="qoConfirmTitle">Confirm</div>
        <div class="modal-body" id="qoConfirmBody"></div>
        <div class="modal-actions">
            <button type="button" class="hdr-btn" id="qoConfirmCancel">Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" class="hdr-btn primary" id="qoConfirmOk">OK</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Order-note modal. Opened from the Notes button in the SO-details
     drawer. Textarea is unbounded so reps can paste in long delivery
     instructions / picking notes; value flows into the ImportSalesOrder
     CSV's `Note` column. -->
<div id="qoOrderNoteModal" class="qo-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="qoOrderNoteTitle">
    <div class="qo-modal-backdrop" onclick="closeOrderNoteModal()"></div>
    <div class="qo-modal-card" style="min-width:480px; max-width:640px;">
        <div class="modal-head" id="qoOrderNoteTitle">Order Note</div>
        <div class="modal-body">
            <p style="margin:0 0 8px; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-2);">
                Written to the sales order's Note field. Visible to picking, shipping, and accounts.
            </p>
            <textarea id="qoOrderNoteTextarea" rows="8"

<!-- Standalone-mode login modal. Hidden in fishbowl mode; opened from

<!-- Portal-mode tenant menu — dropdown anchored under the conn-pill. -->

<!-- Portal-mode FB connect modal. Shown on first portal load (and from
     the header pill via "Connect another tenant") to capture a

     encrypted in KV keyed by the staff's Access email. -->
<div id="qoFbConnectModal" class="qo-login-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">

            Signed in as <strong id="qoFbConnectEmail">…</strong> via Cloudflare Access.<br>

            your password changes.

            <label for="qoFbConnTenant">Tenant Code</label>

            <span class="modal-hint">Provided by your administrator. Don't know it? Ask them.</span>

        <div class="modal-row">
            <label for="qoFbConnUser">Fishbowl Username</label>
            <input type="text" id="qoFbConnUser" autocomplete="username" />

        <div class="modal-row">

<!-- Main layout -->
<div class="h-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden">

    <!-- 56px compact header (mirrors PO Summary) -->

                <div id="statusLine" class="status-line">Loading…</div>

                <span id="qoConnPillLabel">Not connected</span>

                        title="Sign out now — your saved Fishbowl connection is kept" aria-label="Sign out">

                        <line x1="21" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12"/>
                    </svg>
                </button>
            </span>
            <!-- Primary view switch. Uses .view-switch, NOT .btn-group — the
                 latter is display:none below 1024px, and this control must
                 stay reachable on a phone since it is the only way back to

                    <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM14 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM4 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2zM14 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2z"></path></svg>
                    <span class="lbl">Catalog</span>

                <button id="app-view-orders" type="button" onclick="setAppView('orders')"
                        class="hdr-btn" aria-current="false" title="Browse existing sales orders and their status">
                    <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m-6 9l2 2 4-4"></path></svg>

                 which is exactly where this needs to work. -->
            <span id="layoutToggleWrap" class="view-switch" style="display:none;">
                <button id="layoutToggleBtn" type="button" class="hdr-btn"
                        onclick="toggleLayoutPref()" aria-pressed="false"
                        title="Switch to the full desktop layout">
                    <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9.75 17L9 20l-1 1h8l-1-1-.75-3M3 13h18M5 17h14a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z"></path></svg>
                    <span class="lbl">Desktop</span>

            </span>
            <!-- View mode toggle (3 segments) -->
            <div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="View mode">
                <button id="view-btn-tile"      onclick="setViewMode('tile')"       class="hdr-btn active" title="Tile view with images">
                    <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM14 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM4 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2zM14 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2z"></path></svg>

                <button id="view-btn-list-image" onclick="setViewMode('list-image')" class="hdr-btn" title="List view with thumbnails">
                    <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 6h6m4 0h6M4 12h6m4 0h6M4 18h6m4 0h6"></path></svg>

            <select id="pageSizeSelect" onchange="onPageSizeChange()" class="hdr-btn" style="padding:5px 8px; font-size:11px;" title="Products per page">
                <option value="24">24 / page</option>
                <option value="48">48 / page</option>
                <option value="96">96 / page</option>
                <option value="9999">All</option>
            </select>

            <button id="settingsToggleBtn" onclick="toggleSettings()" class="hdr-btn hdr-btn-icon" title="Settings">
                <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z"></path>
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"></path>
                </svg>

                <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <polyline points="6 9 6 2 18 2 18 9"/>
                    <path d="M6 18H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h16a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2"/>

                <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M8.228 9c.549-1.165 2.03-2 3.772-2 2.21 0 4 1.343 4 3 0 1.4-1.278 2.575-3.006 2.907-.542.104-.994.54-.994 1.093M12 17h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/></svg>
            </button>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Filter chip strip — primary filters (customer / tree / stock LG)
         live inline so they're always one click away. The placeholder
         inside each trigger acts as the field label. Secondary filters

         the filters panel and surface as chips on this strip when set. -->
    <div id="filterChipStrip">
        <!-- Customer (single-select) -->
        <div class="ms-container inline" id="cust-ms">
            <div class="ms-trigger" id="custTrigger">
                <span class="ms-placeholder" id="custPlaceholder">Select customer…</span>
            </div>
            <div class="ms-dropdown hidden" id="custDropdown">
                <div class="ms-search">
                    <!-- Back-arrow visible only when the dropdown is

                    <button class="ms-back-btn" type="button" onclick="closeMS()" aria-label="Close" title="Close">
                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/><polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"/></svg>

        <!-- Despatch Location Group (single-select) — fills LocationGroupName
             on the created SO. Defaults to the user's default LG. -->
        <div class="ms-container inline" id="despatchLg-ms">
            <div class="ms-trigger" id="despatchLgTrigger">
                <span class="ms-placeholder" id="despatchLgPlaceholder">Despatch LG…</span>

                <div class="ms-list" id="despatchLgList"></div>

        </div>

        <!-- Product Tree (multi-select) -->
        <div class="ms-container inline" id="tree-ms">
            <div class="ms-trigger" id="treeTrigger">
                <span class="ms-placeholder" id="treePlaceholder">All categories</span>

                <div class="ms-search">
                    <button class="ms-back-btn" type="button" onclick="closeMS()" aria-label="Close" title="Close">
                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/><polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Search categories…" id="treeSearch" />

                <div class="ms-actions"><span id="treeAll">Select All</span><span id="treeClear">Clear All</span></div>
                <div class="ms-list" id="treeList"></div>

                    <button class="ms-back-btn" type="button" onclick="closeMS()" aria-label="Close" title="Close">
                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/><polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Search location groups…" id="lgSearch" />
                </div>
                <div class="ms-actions"><span id="lgAll">Select All</span><span id="lgClear">Clear All</span></div>
                <div class="ms-list" id="lgList"></div>

        </div>

        <!-- Inline text search — always visible. Live-filters with the
             same 250ms debounce as before; matches num / sku / upc /
             description. On phone (< 640px) the search input promotes
             to its own row above the filter chips and the scan button
             becomes visible. -->
        <div class="inline-search">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg>

                    <rect x="10" y="7"  width="4" height="14"/>
                    <rect x="17" y="10" width="4" height="11"/>

            <button id="groupByTreeToggleBtn" onclick="toggleGroupByTree()" class="hdr-btn hdr-btn-icon" title="Group the List / List+Img views by main product category" aria-label="Group by category">
                <!-- Folder/tree glyph — reads as "group by category". -->
                <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
                    <path d="M3 7a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2 2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V7z"/>
                    <path d="M7 13h4M7 16h7"/>

            </button>
            <button id="favouritesToggleBtn" onclick="toggleFavouritesOnly()" class="hdr-btn hdr-btn-icon" title="Favourites filter — click cycles: customer → user → both → off" aria-label="Favourites filter">
                <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <defs>
                        <linearGradient id="favBothGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">

    <!-- Settings panel -->
    <div id="settingsPanel">
        <div class="settings-grid">
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Default SO Status</div>
                <select id="defaultStatusIdSelect" onchange="onDefaultStatusChange()" class="hdr-btn" style="padding:5px 10px; font-size:12px;">
                    <option value="10">Estimate</option>
                    <option value="20" selected>Issued</option>
                </select>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:240px;">Status applied when creating the sales order. Issued = ready to fulfill.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Tier 2 Module Option</div>
                <select id="t2ModuleOptSelect" onchange="onModuleOptChange()" class="hdr-btn" style="padding:5px 10px; font-size:12px;">
                    <option value="low">Lowest list price wins</option>
                    <option value="high">Highest list price wins</option>
                </select>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:260px;">Mirrors <em>Tools → Module Options → Pricing Rule</em>. Tier 2 sets the list price.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Tier 3 Module Option</div>
                <select id="t3ModuleOptSelect" onchange="onModuleOptChange()" class="hdr-btn" style="padding:5px 10px; font-size:12px;">
                    <option value="low">Lowest sales price wins</option>
                    <option value="high">Highest sales price wins</option>
                </select>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:260px;">Tier 3 sets the final sales price.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Price display</div>

                    <input type="checkbox" id="showOrigPriceToggle" checked onchange="onShowOrigPriceChange()">
                    <span>Show product price when a pricing rule applies</span>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:270px;">When a rule adjusts the price, the base product price shows struck-through beside the final price. Untick to show only the final price.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Tile display</div>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="showUpcTileToggle" checked onchange="onShowUpcTileChange()">
                    <span>Show UPC on product tiles</span>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:270px;">Displays each product's UPC opposite the product number on the tile view. List views expose UPC as its own column via the Columns button.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Default view</div>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <span>Open in</span>
                    <select id="defaultViewModeSelect" class="hdr-btn" style="padding:3px 6px; font-size:12px;" onchange="onDefaultViewModeChange()">
                        <option value="list-plain">List (compact)</option>
                        <option value="list-image">List + images</option>
                        <option value="tile">Tiles</option>
                    </select>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Which catalogue view the report opens in. The header toggle still switches views for the current session — this is what you come back to next time. Narrow screens always open in Tiles (the list table doesn't fit).</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Cart order details</div>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="defaultSoDetailsExpandedToggle" checked onchange="onDefaultSoDetailsExpandedChange()">
                    <span>Expand <em>Order details</em> by default</span>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Starts the cart's carrier / ship-to / bill-to / customer-PO block open so those fields are visible without a click. Untick to start it collapsed and keep the cart line items higher up.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Favourites</div>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <span>Show</span>
                    <select id="favDisplayModeSelect" class="hdr-btn" style="padding:3px 6px; font-size:12px;" onchange="onFavDisplayModeChange()">
                        <option value="both">Customer + user favourites</option>
                        <option value="customer">Customer favourites only</option>
                        <option value="user">User favourites only</option>
                    </select>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Controls which favourite stars appear on products and what the header star filter cycles through. Pick a single kind to avoid extra clicks when your team only uses one.</p>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 mt-2">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="autoCreateFavCfToggle" checked onchange="onAutoCreateFavCfChange()">
                    <span>Create favourites custom fields automatically</span>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Customer favourites store in <code>Favourites_1</code>–<code>Favourites_5</code> customer custom fields (512 chars each). When on, each field is created the first time a customer's list actually needs it — nothing is created up front. When off, saves fail until an admin creates the fields manually (type "Long Text", module Customer).</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Image loading</div>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="lazyImagesToggle" checked>
                    <span>Lazy-load product images (recommended for large catalogs)</span>
                </label>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Product UOM grouping</div>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="groupByPartToggle" onchange="onGroupByPartChange()">
                    <span>Group products that share the same part</span>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Collapses each part's UOM variants (e.g. ea / box / case) into a single tile with a UOM dropdown. List views always show every UOM as its own row.</p>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 mt-2">
                    <span>Preferred UOM</span>
                    <select id="groupPreferredUomInput" class="hdr-btn" style="padding:3px 6px; font-size:12px;" onchange="onGroupPreferredUOMChange()">
                        <option value="ea">ea</option>
                    </select>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Default UOM the grouped tile selects first. Falls back to the lowest product ID when no sibling matches.</p>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 mt-2">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="favouriteWholePartToggle" onchange="onFavouriteWholePartChange()">
                    <span>Favourite all UOMs of the same part together</span>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Clicking a star marks every product sharing that part (e.g. ea + box + case) with the same favourite state. Otherwise, only the clicked UOM is marked.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">After creating SO</div>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="autoOpenSoToggle">
                    <span>Jump to the SO module after a successful create</span>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Turn off if you batch-create orders — the toast still shows the new SO number so you can review later.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Debug console</div>
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="showDebugToggle">
                    <span>Show the debug log at the bottom of the page</span>
                </label>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">Logs price-rule resolution, SO submission payloads, and customer-favourite writes. Useful for diagnosing issues; safe to leave off.</p>
            </div>
            <!-- Admin-only: publish current values as the default for every user.
                 Hidden via `display:none` for non-admins (toggled by
                 applyAdminVisibility() once _isAdmin is known). -->
            <div id="adminDefaultsSection" style="display:none;">
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-600 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Admin defaults</div>
                <button onclick="publishAdminDefaults()" class="hdr-btn primary">Save as default for all users</button>
                <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;">
                    Publishes the current SO status, pricing-rule tie-breakers, price display, favourites mode, UOM grouping, preferred UOM, default view, and cart Order-details default as the report-wide default. Users without their own saved override pick up the new value on next load.
                </p>
                <p id="adminDefaultsLastSaved" class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1" style="max-width:280px;"></p>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Reset</div>
                <button onclick="resetSavedSettings()" class="hdr-btn danger">Reset saved settings</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Help panel — toggled by the (?) icon in the header. Same show/hide
         pattern as the filters & settings panels. -->
    <div id="helpPanel">
        <div class="help-grid">
            <div>
                <h3>Getting started</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li>Pick a <strong>Customer</strong> from the filters panel — pricing rules, purchase history and addresses load against this customer.</li>
                    <li><strong>Despatch Location Group</strong> defaults to your user's default LG and stamps <em>LocationGroupName</em> on the created SO.</li>
                    <li><strong>Stock Location Group</strong> controls which inventory totals are shown on the catalogue and feeds the "In stock only" filter — it does NOT affect the created SO.</li>
                </ul>

                <h3>Orders view</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li>The <strong>Catalog / Orders</strong> switch at the top left of the header changes screen. Your cart is kept intact either way.</li>
                    <li>Defaults to <strong>your own sales</strong> — orders where you are the salesman. The salesman dropdown switches to another rep or to everyone.</li>
                    <li>Pick a customer with the first toolbar button (the same picker as the catalogue); the second button toggles between that customer and all customers.</li>
                    <li><strong>Open orders</strong> means Estimate, Issued and In Progress. Fulfilled, Closed Short, Voided, Cancelled and Expired orders appear only under <em>All statuses</em>.</li>
                    <li>Drag a column edge to resize it; the width is remembered.</li>
                    <li><strong>Status</strong> is derived from pick and shipment progress, not just the order's own status: <em>To Pick → Picking → Picked → Packed → Shipped</em>. Hover it to see each pick and shipment. A <code>*</code> means the order has several picks at different stages.</li>
                    <li>Click any order to expand its line items in place, showing ordered / picked / fulfilled quantities per line. Click again to collapse.</li>
                    <li>Filter by date range and open-vs-all status; search by SO number, customer, PO or salesman.</li>
                </ul>

                <h3>Finding products</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li>Switch between <strong>Tile</strong>, <strong>List+Img</strong> and <strong>List</strong> views with the toggle at the top.</li>
                    <li>Filters: product tree, stock LG, free-text search (num / sku / upc / description), in-stock-only, favourites, previously-purchased.</li>
                    <li><strong>★ Favourites</strong> — each product has TWO independent stars: <span style="color:#16a34a;font-weight:600;">green = customer (shared with all staff)</span> and <span style="color:#f97316;font-weight:600;">orange = your personal pick</span>. Click either to toggle on/off; a product can carry both at once. The green star is disabled until you pick a customer (its target). Customer favourites save across the customer's <code>Favourites_1</code>–<code>Favourites_5</code> custom fields (512 characters each — created automatically as needed, or manually in the Custom Fields admin). The header star cycles the FILTER through customer → user → <span style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#16a34a 50%,#f97316 50%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;font-weight:600;">both</span> → off so you can browse one set at a time, or the union. A <strong>Settings ▸ Favourites</strong> option can limit the report to just one kind — the other star disappears and the header filter becomes a simple on/off.</li>
                    <li><strong>Previously purchased</strong> filters to this customer's purchase history.</li>
                    <li><strong>UOM grouping</strong> (settings) — collapses products that share an underlying part into one tile with a UOM dropdown. List views always show every variant.</li>
                    <li>Sort with the dropdown OR click a column header in list views. Drag column edges to resize.</li>
                    <li>In list views, the <strong>Columns</strong> button (next to the view toggle) shows/hides columns and drag-reorders them — the layout is remembered.</li>
                </ul>

                <h3>Pricing</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li>Prices honour Fishbowl's full <strong>Tier 2 / Tier 3 pricing rules</strong> for the selected customer.</li>
                    <li>Hover any price to see the rule that won and the next-qty break.</li>
                    <li>Orange <strong>↑ +N for $X.XX ea</strong> means buying that many more crosses a price break.</li>
                    <li>Cart line prices can be overridden — click the unit-price field, type a new value, Enter to commit. Clear the field to revert.</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <div>
                <h3>Cart</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li>Adjust qty with +/− or type directly. <kbd>Enter</kbd> on a product tile's qty input adds to cart.</li>
                    <li>Drag the hamburger handle on a cart line to <strong>reorder</strong> — the order flows through to the created SO's line sequence.</li>
                    <li>The blue pill below each line total shows the <strong>tax code</strong> that will apply. Customer-default tax wins; otherwise the product's own.</li>
                    <li>Cart is per-session — not persisted across reloads.</li>
                </ul>

                <h3>Creating the sales order</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li>Pick ship-to and bill-to addresses in the cart header.</li>
                    <li>Default SO status (Estimate / Issued) is set in <strong>Settings</strong>.</li>
                    <li>Click the cart icon to confirm and submit — Fishbowl auto-numbers the SO.</li>
                    <li>On success a toast shows the new SO number and opens it in the SO module.</li>
                </ul>

                <h3>Tips</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li>Click any product number to jump to it in the Product module.</li>
                    <li>Hover the <strong>stock</strong> badge for per-LG breakdown; hover the <strong>PO</strong> badge for incoming-stock details.</li>
                    <li>Settings (gear icon) controls SO status, pricing-rule tie-breakers, and lazy image loading.</li>
                    <li>Reset saved settings to clear view mode, filters, favourites and column widths back to defaults.</li>
                </ul>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Content: products (flex-1) + cart panel (320px) -->

        <div id="productArea" class="custom-scrollbar">
            <div id="productHost"></div>
            <div id="pagination"></div>

             which is shown. The cart panel stays visible in both views. -->

                         path for selecting a customer, not two. -->

                    <button id="ordersScopeBtn" class="hdr-btn ot-pill" onclick="toggleOrdersScope()"

                        <span class="lbl" id="ordersScopeBtnLabel">All customers</span>
                    </button>
                    <!-- Filters are buttons that open a popover, not native
                         <select>s. A shrunken select reads as a squashed
                         desktop control on a phone; this collapses cleanly to
                         an icon and gives a full-size tap target per option. -->
                    <button id="ordersSalesmanBtn" class="hdr-btn ot-pill" onclick="openOrdersMenu('salesman', this)" title="Salesman">
                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/></svg>
                        <span class="lbl" id="ordersSalesmanBtnLabel">My sales</span>

                    <button id="ordersRangeBtn" class="hdr-btn ot-pill" onclick="openOrdersMenu('range', this)" title="Date range">
                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/><line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/></svg>

                    <button id="ordersStatusBtn" class="hdr-btn ot-pill" onclick="openOrdersMenu('status', this)" title="Status filter">
                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"/></svg>
                        <span class="lbl" id="ordersStatusBtnLabel">Open orders</span>

                <div class="ot-row ot-search-row">

                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg>

                        <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15"></path></svg>
                    </button>
                    <div id="ordersStatusLine" class="status-line"></div>

            </div>
            <div id="ordersScroll" class="custom-scrollbar">

                <div id="ordersFooter"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <aside id="cartPanel">
            <div class="cart-header">

            <!-- SO-detail drawer. Holds the SO-level fields the rep would

                 stay visible above the fold; the summary row in the
                 header strip shows the most useful at-a-glance values
                 (carrier name + truncated ship-to) so the rep can verify
                 without expanding. Required by ImportSalesOrder CSV
                 columns (BillTo* / ShipTo* / CarrierName / PONum /
                 OrderDateScheduled). -->
            <div id="soDetails" style="display:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-default); background:#f8fafc; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; overflow:hidden; flex-shrink:0;">
                <!-- Collapse trigger — the whole row is clickable. Shows
                     a one-line summary so the rep can verify carrier +
                     ship-to without expanding. -->
                <button type="button" id="soDetailsToggle"
                        onclick="toggleSoDetails()"

                <!-- Expanded body. Hidden via display:none; toggleSoDetails
                     flips it. Holds carrier + customer-PO + date-scheduled

                <div id="soDetailsBody" style="display:none; padding:8px 14px 10px; font-size:11px;">

                    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px 10px; margin-bottom:6px;">
                        <label style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0;" title="Carrier — defaults to the customer's default carrier, or the company default if the customer has none">
