                            <input id="customerPoInput" type="text" oninput="onCustomerPoChange(this.value)" placeholder="(optional)"
                                   style="min-width:0; padding:4px 6px; font-size:11px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; font-family:inherit;" />
                        </label>
                        <label style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0; grid-column:1 / -1;" title="Date Scheduled — written to the SO's OrderDateScheduled field">
                            <span style="font-weight:600; color:#475569; font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em;">Date Scheduled</span>
                            <input id="dateScheduledInput" type="date" onchange="onDateScheduledChange(this.value)"
                                   style="min-width:0; padding:3px 6px; font-size:11px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; font-family:inherit;" />
                        </label>
                        <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0; grid-column:1 / -1;">
                            <span style="font-weight:600; color:#475569; font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em;">Notes</span>
                            <button type="button" id="orderNoteBtn" onclick="openOrderNoteModal()"
                                    title="Add a free-text note — written to the SO's Note field"
                                    style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-width:0; padding:5px 8px; font-size:11px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; color:#0f172a; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; text-align:left;">
                                <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="flex-shrink:0; color:#475569;">
                                    <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                                    <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                                    <line x1="9" y1="13" x2="15" y2="13"/>
                                    <line x1="9" y1="17" x2="13" y2="17"/>
                                </svg>
                                <span id="orderNoteBtnLabel" style="flex:1; min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; color:#64748b; font-weight:400;">(click to add note)</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; min-width:0;">
                        <label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-width:0;" title="Ship-to address">
                            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="flex-shrink:0;">
                                <path d="M14 18V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v11a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h2"/>
                                <path d="M15 18H9"/>
                                <path d="M19 18h2a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-3.65a1 1 0 0 0-.22-.624l-3.48-4.35A1 1 0 0 0 17.52 8H14"/>
                                <circle cx="17" cy="18" r="2"/>
                                <circle cx="7" cy="18" r="2"/>
                            </svg>
                            <select id="shipToSelect" onchange="onAddressChange('ship', this.value)" class="hdr-btn" style="flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; max-width:100%; padding:4px 6px; font-size:11px; text-overflow:ellipsis;"></select>
                        </label>
                        <label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-width:0;" title="Bill-to address">
                            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="flex-shrink:0;">
                                <line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="22"/>
                                <path d="M17 5H9.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H6"/>
                            </svg>
                            <select id="billToSelect" onchange="onAddressChange('bill', this.value)" class="hdr-btn" style="flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; max-width:100%; padding:4px 6px; font-size:11px; text-overflow:ellipsis;"></select>
                        </label>
                    </div>

                    <div id="addressWarning" style="display:none; color:#b91c1c; font-size:10px; margin-top:6px;">
                        No addresses on file — add one in the Customer module.
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Back-compat alias so any legacy refs to #addressPickers still
                 resolve to something meaningful (display toggling logic). -->
            <div id="addressPickers" style="display:none;"></div>
            <div class="cart-list custom-scrollbar" id="cartList">
                <div class="cart-empty">Select a customer and start adding products.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="cart-totals" id="cartTotals">
                <div class="total-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span id="cartSubtotal">$0.00</span></div>
                <div class="total-row"><span>Tax</span><span id="cartTax">—</span></div>
                <div class="total-row grand"><span>Total</span><span id="cartTotal">$0.00</span></div>
            </div>
        </aside>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// QuickOrder — global state, persistence, queries, rendering, cart, SO
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const SETTINGS_KEY = 'cdx.bi.quickorder.v1';
const FB_CONN_KEY  = 'cdx.bi.fbconn.v1';

// MODE has three values:
//   'fishbowl'   — running inside the desktop JxBrowser host (runQuery /
//                  runQueryAsync globals) OR the iOS mobile app
//                  (runRestApiAsync).
//   'portal'     — page is loaded via a Cloudflare Worker proxy URL.
//                  The page is loaded from a Pages domain protected by
//                  Cloudflare Access (OTP). Same-origin `/api/*` fetches
//                  hit a Pages Function that injects the authenticated
//                  user's email and forwards to the upstream Worker —
//                  no API key in the URL, no Bearer token in JS.
//   'standalone' — page reaches the FB REST API directly. Requires the
//                  Connect modal to capture username/password and a
//                  token, and assumes the FB server allows CORS (or is
//                  same-origin). Practically only works from inside the
//                  LAN that hosts the FB server.

// Portal hosts — Pages deployments where `/api/*` is served by a Pages
// Function gateway sitting behind Cloudflare Access. Detection by
// hostname (no URL params needed). `pages.dev` kept as a fallback for
// preview deployments / pre-Access debugging.
const PORTAL_HOSTS = ['0xaha.com', 'quickorder-portal.pages.dev'];
const _isPortalHost = PORTAL_HOSTS.includes(location.hostname);

const MODE = (typeof runQuery === 'function'
           || typeof runQueryAsync === 'function'
           || typeof runRestApiAsync === 'function') ? 'fishbowl'
       : _isPortalHost ? 'portal'
       : 'standalone';

// Connection state. Reused across 'standalone' and 'portal' modes so
// every fetch site (standaloneQuery, image fetch, REST POSTs) works
// without branching. In portal mode `baseUrl` is empty so fetches
// resolve relative — same-origin — and the Cloudflare Access cookie
// rides along automatically. No Bearer token from JS.
let _conn = { baseUrl: 'http://localhost:2456', username: '', appName: 'Quick Order', appId: 102, token: null };
if (MODE === 'portal') {
    _conn.baseUrl = '';
    _conn.token = null;
    _conn.username = 'portal';
} else if (MODE === 'standalone') {
    try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(FB_CONN_KEY);
        if (raw) Object.assign(_conn, JSON.parse(raw));
    } catch (_) { /* ignore corrupt localStorage */ }
}
function persistConn() {
    // Only standalone mode persists the legacy FB_CONN structure;
    // portal mode stores its API key separately in PORTAL_KEY_LS at
    // detection time.
    if (MODE !== 'standalone') return;
    try { localStorage.setItem(FB_CONN_KEY, JSON.stringify(_conn)); }
    catch (_) { /* quota / disabled */ }
}

// The install's short date format.
//
// getProperty() is a FISHBOWL BRIDGE — it exists only inside the desktop
// JxBrowser host. In portal and standalone mode it is undefined, so this
// used to fall back to the hardcoded US 'MM/dd/yyyy' on an install
// configured dd/MM/yyyy, with two consequences:
//
//   * every date DISPLAYED in the portal was month-first; and
//   * far worse, every date WRITTEN by the CSV import path was month-first
//     too. The importer reads the install's own format, so 15 August 2026
//     went out as "08/15/2026" and came back as day 08 / month 15 — and
//     month 15 rolls over to March of the next year. That is where orders
//     created on 15/08/2026 acquired a date of 8 March 2027.
//
// So the value is resolved from the bridge when there is one, and read
// straight out of sysproperties otherwise (see loadDateFormat, called
// early in bootstrapData BEFORE anything renders or submits). Both are
// mutable because the query result arrives after this module loads.
let FB_DATE_FORMAT = (typeof getProperty === 'function')
    ? getProperty('DateFormatShort', 'MM/dd/yyyy') : 'MM/dd/yyyy';
let _dateFormatResolved = (typeof getProperty === 'function');
// Java (SimpleDateFormat) -> moment token conversion. The old inline version
// handled yyyy/yy/dd but NOT a single `d`: an install configured `d/MM/yyyy`
// produced the moment pattern `d/MM/YYYY`, where `d` is day-OF-WEEK (0-6),
// so every date rendered with a number between 0 and 6 in the day position.
// This install is dd/MM/yyyy so it was unaffected, but the trap is one
// character away.
function javaToMomentFormat(f) {
    return String(f || 'MM/dd/yyyy')
        .replace(/y{4}/g, 'YYYY')
        .replace(/y{2}/g, 'YY')
        .replace(/d{1,2}/g, m => (m.length === 2 ? 'DD' : 'D'))
        .replace(/E{3,}/g, 'ddd');
}
let MOMENT_FMT = javaToMomentFormat(FB_DATE_FORMAT);

// Read DateFormatShort out of the database when the getProperty bridge is
// absent (portal / standalone). Everything that formats or parses a date
// reads MOMENT_FMT at CALL time, so refreshing the variable is enough —
// nothing needs re-rendering, provided this runs before the first render.
//
// Failing closed is not an option here: leaving the US default in place is
// exactly the bug. On failure the report keeps the fallback but says so
// loudly, because the consequence is mis-dated sales orders, not cosmetics.
async function loadDateFormat() {
    if (_dateFormatResolved) return;
    try {
        const rows = await qp(`
            SELECT sysValue AS v FROM sysproperties
            WHERE sysKey = 'DateFormatShort' LIMIT 1
        `);
        const v = rows && rows.length ? String(rows[0].v || '').trim() : '';
        if (v) {
            FB_DATE_FORMAT = v;
            MOMENT_FMT = javaToMomentFormat(v);
            _dateFormatResolved = true;
            if (DEBUG) qoDebug('DateFormatShort resolved from sysproperties: '
                + v + ' -> ' + MOMENT_FMT);
            return;
        }
        throw new Error('DateFormatShort not set');
    } catch (e) {
        qoDebug('Could not read DateFormatShort (' + (e && e.message || e) + '). Dates will '
              + 'use ' + FB_DATE_FORMAT + '. If that is not this server\'s format, dates on '
              + 'CREATED sales orders will be wrong, not just displayed wrong.', 'warn');
        // Surfaced, not just logged: the failure mode is a mis-dated order,
        // which nobody notices until someone chases a delivery.
        showToast('Could not read this server\'s date format — falling back to '
                + FB_DATE_FORMAT + '. Check dates on any order you create.', 'error', 9000);
    }
}
// Debug console visibility — saved per user via the Settings checkbox.
// `let` not `const` so the toggle handler can flip it at runtime;
// `loadSavedState` applies the persisted value once settings are loaded.
let DEBUG = false;

// ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let _allProducts = [];          // [{id, num, description, price, sku, upc, taxrate, taxratecode, treeid, treename, uomname, partId, url}]
let _filteredProducts = [];     // after filter+search+sort, before pagination

// UOM grouping — when on, products that share an underlying part collapse
// into a single tile whose UOM dropdown swaps between the siblings.
//   _groupByPart    user-toggleable in Settings; persisted.
//   _partGroups     Map<partId, productId[]>  built from _allProducts.
//   _groupPrimary   Map<productId, productId> — every member maps to the
//                   primary (default-shown) product for that group. The
//                   primary is the member whose UOM matches the "preferred
//                   UOM" setting (e.g. 'ea'), else the lowest product.id.
//   _groupedHidden  Set<productId> — non-primary group members; skipped
//                   by the filter pass when _groupByPart is on.
let _groupByPart = false;
let _groupPreferredUOM = 'ea';
// When ON, toggling a product's favourite star applies the same state
// to every other product sharing that product's `partId`. Reads as
// "this physical part is a favourite regardless of UOM". When OFF
// (default), only the clicked product is marked. Independent of the
// `_groupByPart` display setting — applies even when grouping is off,
// since that's exactly when siblings render as separate tiles and the
// user might toggle one without realising the others stay unmarked.
let _favouriteWholePart = false;

// Layered settings — admin-master defaults overlay the per-user payload
// for keys the user hasn't customised themselves. Same pattern as
// Manufacturing/WO_Capacity_Planning_Gantt_v4.htm and
// Dashboards/Dashboard_Combined.htm:
//   1. Per-user via loadSettings/saveSettings — wins when present
//   2. Admin master via loadReportData/saveReportData — shared blob,
//      writable in practice only by the admin (anyone CAN write it; the
//      auto-publish path is gated on _isAdmin so non-admins don't
//      stomp the master). Picks up where per-user is missing a key.
//   3. Hardcoded fallback (currently just 'ea' for groupPreferredUOM).
// Admin detection: sysuser.id matches getProperty('BI_ADMIN_USER_ID','1')
// OR userName matches getProperty('BI_ADMIN_USER','').
let _isAdmin = false;
let _adminDefaults = {};   // { groupPreferredUOM, ... } — last read from loadReportData

let _partGroups = new Map();
let _groupPrimary = new Map();
let _groupedHidden = new Set();
let _customers = [];            // [{id, num, name, taxrateid, defaultsalesmanid, defaultpaymenttermsid, ...}]
let _selectedCustomer = null;
let _productTrees = [];         // [{id, name, parentId}]  (adjacency tree)
// Client-side product-tree hierarchy, built by buildTreeIndex() from
// _productTrees. Fishbowl's producttree is an adjacency list (parentId,
// with a single synthetic root "Product" id=1). We index it so the
// Category filter can render nested folders with cascade selection, and
// so list/print grouping can resolve a tag → its MAIN (top-level) category.
let _treeById   = new Map();    // id → { id, name, parentId, children:[] }
let _treeRoots  = [];           // nodes with no parent (parentId null/0)
let _treeExpanded = new Set();  // expanded node ids in the Category filter
// List / List+Img: group rows under their MAIN (top-level) product
// category. Persisted. Products tagged across multiple main categories
// appear under each (per user spec). Tile view is never grouped.
let _groupByTree = false;
// Count of items currently paginated (products in tile view; expanded
// rows in a grouped list view) — drives renderPagination / goToPage.
let _pageItemCount = 0;
let _activeRules = [];          // pricing rules pre-filtered for the selected customer
let _customerParts = new Map(); // productId -> {lastprice, datelastpurchased, lastqty} — soitem-derived, for display/history
// Authoritative per-customer last price from the `customerparts` denorm
// table — resolved ONLY when a pricing rule uses the "Customer Last
// Price" base (paBaseAmountTypeId 7). Never applied implicitly; with no
// applicable rule the price is simply product.price. (The soitem-derived
// map above stays as the display source for date/qty.)
let _customerLastPrice = new Map(); // productId -> lastPrice (number)
let _resolvedPrices = new Map();// productId|qty -> {price, original, ruleName}

let _cart = new Map();          // productId -> {qty, product, resolved}
// Catalogue view modes, in header-button order.
//   _defaultViewMode — the persisted SETTING (per-user, admin-publishable)
//                      deciding which view the report opens in.
//   _viewMode        — the live session view.
// Flipping the header toggle only changes the session; the default is
// changed in Settings ▸ Default view, so the setting stays authoritative
// rather than being silently overwritten by the last view used.
const VIEW_MODES = ['tile', 'list-image', 'list-plain'];
let _defaultViewMode = 'list-plain';
let _viewMode = _defaultViewMode;

// ── Outer view: which SCREEN is showing ──────────────────────────────
// _viewMode above is the INNER, catalogue-only tile/list toggle and has no
// meaning while _appView === 'orders'. Session-only and deliberately not
// persisted — the report always opens on the catalogue, which is what a rep
// wants 95% of the time.
const APP_VIEWS = ['catalog', 'orders'];
let _appView = 'catalog';

// Orders view state.
let _orders          = [];        // header rows, newest first, as fetched
let _ordersFiltered  = [];        // after the client-side search box
let _ordersLoading   = false;
let _ordersError     = null;
let _ordersScope     = 'customer';// 'customer' | 'all' — coerced to 'all' with no customer
let _ordersRange     = 90;        // days; 0 = all time
let _ordersStatusSet = 'open';    // 'open' | 'all'
let _ordersSearch    = '';
let _ordersLimit     = 300;
let _ordersSort      = { key: 'so_sched', dir: -1 };
let _ordersExpanded  = null;      // soId of the open detail row, or null
const _soLines       = new Map(); // soId -> line rows (lazy, cached)
// Salesman filter. Defaults to 'me' — a rep opening this view wants their
// own orders, not the whole company's. '' means everyone; any other value
// is a literal so.salesman username.
let _ordersSalesman  = 'me';
let _salesmen        = [];        // [{ userName, count }] — who actually has orders
let _salesmenLoaded  = false;
let _pageSize = 24;
let _pageIndex = 0;
// Compound `field-dir` string: 'name-asc', 'price-desc', 'last-purchased-desc', etc.
// Legacy bare values ('name', 'num', 'last-purchased') are migrated on load.
let _sortBy = 'num-asc';

// Despatch LG — single LG used to stamp LocationGroupName on the created SO.
// Defaults to the user's default LG from usertolg.defaultFlag. Distinct from
// _filters.locationGroupIds, which only filter the catalogue's inventory view.
let _despatchLg = null;   // { id, name } or null

// Filter state
let _filters = {
    productTreeIds: new Set(),     // Set<string>
    locationGroupIds: new Set(),   // Set<string>  drives inventory display + filter
    search: '',
    previouslyPurchasedOnly: false,
    inStockOnly: false,            // hide products with 0 qty in selected LG(s)
    // Tri-state favourites filter:
    //   null       — no filter applied (header star outline)
    //   'customer' — show only the selected customer's saved favourites
    //   'user'     — show only this user's personal favourites
    favouritesMode: null,
    activeOnly: true,
};

let _defaultStatusId = 20;
let _lazyImages = true;
// When a pricing rule adjusts a product's price, show the base product
// price struck-through beside the final price. Off = only the final
// price renders (no cross-out), reducing noise for orgs where rule
// pricing IS the price.
let _showOrigPrice = true;
// Show the product's UPC on each tile (right-aligned, opposite the
// product number, smaller font). List views expose UPC as its own
// toggleable column instead. Per-user persisted + admin-publishable.
let _showUpcTile = true;
// Which favourite implementations are surfaced in the UI:
//   'both' (default) — green customer star + orange user star
//   'customer'       — customer stars only
//   'user'           — personal stars only
// Hides the other kind's star on tiles/rows and trims the header
// favourites-filter cycle, so orgs using a single implementation don't
// see (or click through) the one they don't use.
let _favDisplayMode = 'both';
// After a successful SO create, jump to the SO module to show the new
// order. Default true (existing behaviour). Reps who batch-create
// orders set this off so they can keep building the next quote without
// bouncing in and out of the SO module each time.
let _autoOpenSo = true;
let _activeMS = null;

// ── Pricing-rule module options ──────────────────────────────────────
// Mirrors Fishbowl's "Tools → Module Options" on the Pricing Rule
// module. Each tier's competition can be configured to pick the lowest
// or highest resulting price among the top-ranked rules. Default both
// to 'low' — that's the standard "give the customer the best deal"
// behaviour and matches fishbowl-pricing-rules.html's default preset.
let _t2ModuleOpt = 'low';   // 'low' | 'high' — list-price competition
let _t3ModuleOpt = 'low';   // 'low' | 'high' — sales-price competition

// ── Per-product side data ────────────────────────────────────────────
// All three caches are populated lazily — batches fire per-page as rows
// render, rather than loading every product upfront. This keeps the
// initial paint snappy on large catalogues (5k+ products).
//
//   _partData    productId -> { leadTime, vendorName }
//   _inventory   productId -> Map<lgId, qty>
//   _openPOs     productId -> [{ poNum, qtyToFulfill, qtyFulfilled, qtyRemaining,
//                                dateScheduled, vendorName, statusId }, …]
// Each cache stores `null` when we've confirmed there's no row (avoids
// re-querying the same product on every scroll).
const _partData  = new Map();
const _inventory = new Map();
const _openPOs   = new Map();
// Cost bases for pricing rules — partId -> { avg, std, vendor, last }.
//   avg    = partcost.avgCost          ("Average Cost" base)
//   std    = part.stdCost              ("Standard Cost" base)
//   vendor = vendorparts.lastCost of the defaultFlag vendor
//   last   = vendorparts.lastCost with the most recent lastDate
// Loaded once per session, and only when an active rule actually
// references a cost base (see loadPartCosts / ruleUsesCostBase).
const _partCosts = new Map();
let _partCostsLoaded = false;
let _locationGroups = []; // [{id, name}] for the LG filter
let _uoms = [];           // [{code, name}] active UOMs — populates the Preferred UOM dropdown

// Customer addresses — populated when a customer is selected. Drives the
// ship-to / bill-to selectors required by the ImportSalesOrder CSV.
let _customerAddresses = [];   // [{id, label, recipient, street, city, state, zip, country, defaultFlag, typeId, typeName, residential}]
let _selectedShipToId = null;  // pointer into _customerAddresses
let _selectedBillToId = null;

// SO-detail fields surfaced in the cart drawer + the confirmation modal,
// and emitted into the ImportSalesOrder CSV. Carrier defaults to the
// customer's defaultCarrierId; if that's empty we fall back to the
// company's defaultCarrierId (loaded once at bootstrap into
// _companyDefaults). Customer PO + date scheduled are per-order — they
// reset when the user picks a different customer or after a successful
// submit.
let _carriers           = [];     // [{id, name}] — for the carrier dropdown
let _companyDefaults    = { carrierId: null, carrierName: '' };  // fallback when customer has no default
let _orderCarrierId     = null;   // selected carrier (overrides customer default for this order)
let _orderCarrierName   = '';     // mirror of selected carrier name (for CSV)
let _orderCustomerPO    = '';     // ImportSalesOrder CSV `PONum`
let _orderDateScheduled = '';     // YYYY-MM-DD string (HTML date input format); converted to MOMENT_FMT in CSV
// Order-level free-text note — emitted into the CSV `Note` column.
// Edited via the Notes modal (the field can be long enough that an
// inline input would feel cramped). Resets on customer change and
// after a successful submit.
let _orderNote          = '';
// Cart drawer expanded/collapsed state for the SO-detail block.
//   _defaultSoDetailsExpanded — persisted SETTING (per-user,
//     admin-publishable): whether "Order details" starts expanded.
//     Expanded by default so the rep sees carrier / ship-to / PO without
//     an extra click; orgs that want the line items higher up turn it off
//     in Settings ▸ Cart order details.
//   _soDetailsExpanded — live session state, flipped by the chevron.
let _defaultSoDetailsExpanded = true;
let _soDetailsExpanded  = _defaultSoDetailsExpanded;

// Favourites — tri-state per product, cycled by clicking the star.
//   none      → no flag (star outline, grey)
//   'customer'→ saved on the SELECTED customer's record (shared across
//               all staff who work with that customer). Persisted in the
//               `Favourites` (or `Favorites`) custom field on customer.
//   'user'    → saved against this staff user (visible only to them).
//               Persisted in this report's saveSettings blob.
// _userFavourites stores product NUMBERS (private to this user's local
// settings blob; kept as nums so a user's list survives a DB rebuild).
// _customerFavourites stores product IDs — the customer's shared list
// persists to the customer record keyed by product id. Both are
// converted to ID sets at runtime in _userFavIds / _customerFavIds so
// the rest of the code can do O(1) ID lookups.
let _userFavourites     = new Set();   // Set<string productNum>
let _customerFavourites = new Set();   // Set<number productId> for the currently-loaded customer
let _userFavIds         = new Set();   // Set<number productId> — derived
let _customerFavIds     = new Set();   // Set<number productId> — derived
// Which custom-field key the current customer stores favourites in.
// Either 'Favourites' or 'Favorites'. Captured on customer load so writes
// target the same key the customer already uses; falls back to the
// install-wide detected name (_installFavouritesFieldName) when the
// customer has neither key set yet.
let _customerFavouritesFieldName = 'Favourites';
// Install-wide detected BASE spelling ('Favourites' or 'Favorites') —
// set once at bootstrap by querying the `customfield` table. Canonical
// storage is the numbered fields <base>_1..<base>_5 (512-char CF limit);
// the import CSV writes columns `CF-<base>_1`..`CF-<base>_5`. Defaults
// to 'Favourites' (UK).
let _installFavouritesFieldName = 'Favourites';
// Exact names of the favourites custom fields that EXIST on this
// install (numbered + legacy, both spellings) — populated by
// detectInstallFavouritesFieldName. Writes only reference existing
// columns (a missing CF column fails the whole import row); missing
// numbered fields are lazily created when _autoCreateFavCf is on.
let _favCfExisting = new Set();
// Create missing Favourites_<n> customer custom fields on demand — the
// first time a customer's list actually needs that field. Nothing is
// created up front: Favourites_2 only comes into existence once some
// list overflows Favourites_1's 512 chars. Settings-toggleable and
// admin-publishable.
let _autoCreateFavCf = true;
// Candidate REST paths for the Customer import. Fishbowl's REST API
// exposes imports under /api/import/{Type} but the Type for Customer
// varies by version — some installs use 'Customer', others use the
// hyphenated 'Customer-Default' (their default Customer import file
// name) or accept multiple spellings. We try each in turn and cache
// the first one that doesn't return "Import not found", so subsequent
// saves go straight to the resolved path. Order = most-likely-first.
const _customerImportPathCandidates = [
    // Customers, PLURAL, first -- this is the documented one. POST /import/:name
    // takes "the case-sensitive default name of the CSV import/export with '-'
    // replacing any spaces", and Fishbowl's customer import is named
    // "Customers".
    //
    // The singular used to be first, which cost a real site their favourites
    // saves: an unresolvable :name answers 500 with a bare Spring error body
    // and no message, the probe loop read that as a genuine rejection rather
    // than a wrong path, stopped, and never reached the plural.
    '/api/import/Customers',
    '/api/import/Customer',
    '/api/import/Customer-Default',
    '/api/import/customer',
    '/api/import/ImportCustomer',
];
let _resolvedCustomerImportPath = null;
// Wire format this server accepts on POST /api/import/:name — 'json' (an
// array of row arrays) or 'csv' (text). JSON is tried first and is strictly
// better; see _postCustomerImport. null = not yet determined.
let _importEncoding = null;
// Candidate REST paths for the Custom Fields import (used to auto-
// create Favourites_1.._5). Probed most-likely-first, same pattern as
// the customer import above.
const _customFieldImportPathCandidates = [
    '/api/import/Custom-Fields',
    '/api/import/CustomFields',
    '/api/import/Custom-Field',
    '/api/import/CustomField',
];
let _resolvedCustomFieldImportPath = null;
// Debounced writer for customer-favourite changes — multiple stars
// flipped in quick succession coalesce into one backend call.
// Other customer custom fields on the record are preserved automatically:
// ImportCustomer only updates columns present in the CSV, and we only
// include the CF-<favourites> column.
let _customerFavouritesSaveTimer = null;

// List-view column widths (px) — keyed by data-col attribute on the th.
// Populated when the user drags a column resize handle; persisted under
// saveSettings so layout sticks across reloads.
let _colWidths = {};

// List-view column registry — order + visibility for the data columns
// of both list views, driven by the Columns dropdown (same pattern as
// PurchaseOrderSummary). qty + action are pinned trailing columns and
// deliberately NOT part of this registry; thumb only renders in
// list-image mode regardless of its vis flag.
const LIST_COL_DEFS = [
    { key: 'fav',     label: 'Favourites' },
    { key: 'thumb',   label: 'Image (List+Img view)' },
    { key: 'num',     label: 'Product #' },
    { key: 'upc',     label: 'UPC' },
    { key: 'desc',    label: 'Description' },
    { key: 'catpath', label: 'Category', defVis: false },  // full path "Main › Sub"; off by default
    { key: 'last',    label: 'Last purchased' },
    { key: 'stock',   label: 'Stock' },
    { key: 'lead',    label: 'Lead time' },
    { key: 'onorder', label: 'On order' },
    { key: 'price',   label: 'Price' },
];
let _listCols = LIST_COL_DEFS.map(c => ({ key: c.key, vis: c.defVis !== false }));
let _colDragIdx = null;   // drag source index while reordering the panel

// ── Product image cache ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// Fishbowl stores product images as base64 longtext in the `image` table,
// keyed by tableName='product' + recordId=product.id. The thumbnail blob
// can be huge (50–200KB), so we never JOIN it into the main product query.
// Instead, the lazy-loader collects productIds for visible images and
// batch-queries the `image` table in chunks.
//   _thumbCache: productId -> base64 string  (or `null` when no row exists)
const _thumbCache = new Map();
// Default placeholder shown until either (a) we know the product has no
// image, or (b) the real thumbnail loads in. Inline data URI so no
// flicker on first paint.
const PLACEHOLDER_SVG =
    'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + encodeURIComponent(
        '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5">' +
        '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"/></svg>'
    );

// ── Persistence (mirrors PO Summary 607–682) ─────────────────────────
// Read settings from Fishbowl when available; fall back to localStorage
// in standalone mode (browser tab or iOS app's report viewer).
function _readSettings(key) {
    if (typeof loadSettings === 'function') return loadSettings(key);
    try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch (_) { return null; }
}
function _writeSettings(key, value) {
    if (typeof saveSettings === 'function') { saveSettings(key, value); return; }
    try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (_) { /* quota / disabled */ }
}

// ── Admin-master settings overlay ──────────────────────────────────
// Mirrors WO_Capacity_Planning_Gantt_v4.htm and Dashboard_Combined.htm.
// Master payload lives in saveReportData (single blob per saved report,
// visible to every user). We currently only persist `groupPreferredUOM`
// here, but the shape supports any number of keys — extend `keys` in
// _saveAdminDefaults / consume more fields in _loadAdminDefaults.

function _detectAdmin() {
    try {
        if (typeof getUser !== 'function') return false;
        const u = JSON.parse(getUser() || '{}');
        const adminId = (typeof getProperty === 'function')
            ? getProperty('BI_ADMIN_USER_ID', '1') : '1';
        const adminUser = (typeof getProperty === 'function')
            ? getProperty('BI_ADMIN_USER', '') : '';
        if (u.id != null && String(u.id) === String(adminId)) return true;
        if (adminUser && u.userName && u.userName === adminUser) return true;
    } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
    return false;
}

function _loadAdminDefaults() {
    if (typeof loadReportData !== 'function') return;
    try {
        const raw = loadReportData();
        if (!raw) return;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') _adminDefaults = parsed;
    } catch (_) { /* no master yet */ }
}

// Persist current admin-publishable values to the report-level blob.
// Gated on _isAdmin — non-admins calling this is a silent no-op so a
// rogue script can't corrupt the shared default. The function ALWAYS
// preserves keys it doesn't know about, so a future report version
// adding more admin defaults doesn't trample on existing ones.
//
// Set of keys published as admin defaults — the structural/business
// settings that benefit from a tenant-wide default. Truly per-user
// preferences (pageSize, lazyImages, autoOpenSo) are NOT included; they
// stay per-user only. To add a new admin-publishable setting: add it to
// both ADMIN_KEYS and _applyAdminDefaultsToState.
//
// defaultViewMode / defaultSoDetailsExpanded are the *defaults*, not the
// live session values — an admin publishing them sets the starting point
// for users who haven't chosen their own, and each user can still
// override in their own Settings.
const ADMIN_KEYS = [
    'groupPreferredUOM',
    'groupByPart',
    'favouriteWholePart',
    'defaultStatusId',
    't2ModuleOpt',
    't3ModuleOpt',
    'showOrigPrice',
    'showUpcTile',
    'favDisplayMode',
    'autoCreateFavCf',
    'defaultViewMode',
    'defaultSoDetailsExpanded',
];

function _saveAdminDefaults() {
    if (!_isAdmin || typeof saveReportData !== 'function') return false;
    const payload = { ...(_adminDefaults || {}) };
    payload.groupPreferredUOM   = _groupPreferredUOM || 'ea';
    payload.groupByPart         = !!_groupByPart;
    payload.favouriteWholePart  = !!_favouriteWholePart;
    payload.defaultStatusId     = _defaultStatusId;
    payload.t2ModuleOpt         = _t2ModuleOpt;
    payload.t3ModuleOpt         = _t3ModuleOpt;
    payload.showOrigPrice       = !!_showOrigPrice;
    payload.showUpcTile         = !!_showUpcTile;
    payload.favDisplayMode      = _favDisplayMode;
    payload.autoCreateFavCf     = !!_autoCreateFavCf;
    payload.defaultViewMode     = _defaultViewMode;
    payload.defaultSoDetailsExpanded = !!_defaultSoDetailsExpanded;
    payload.savedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    payload.savedBy = (() => {
        try { return (JSON.parse(getUser() || '{}')).userName || ''; } catch (_) { return ''; }
    })();
    try { saveReportData(JSON.stringify(payload)); _adminDefaults = payload; return true; }
    catch (e) { console.warn('saveReportData failed:', e); return false; }
}

// Overlay admin defaults onto the live state. Called from loadSavedState
// BEFORE per-user state is read, so the per-user values win wherever
// they exist. Each key reads from _adminDefaults and only applies if
// the type matches — guards against a future version writing wrong
// types into the shared blob.
function _applyAdminDefaultsToState() {
    const d = _adminDefaults;
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object') return;
    if (typeof d.groupPreferredUOM === 'string' && d.groupPreferredUOM.trim()) {
        _groupPreferredUOM = d.groupPreferredUOM.trim();
    }
    if (typeof d.groupByPart === 'boolean')        _groupByPart        = d.groupByPart;
    if (typeof d.favouriteWholePart === 'boolean') _favouriteWholePart = d.favouriteWholePart;
    if (typeof d.defaultStatusId === 'number')     _defaultStatusId    = d.defaultStatusId;
    if (d.t2ModuleOpt === 'low' || d.t2ModuleOpt === 'high') _t2ModuleOpt = d.t2ModuleOpt;
    if (d.t3ModuleOpt === 'low' || d.t3ModuleOpt === 'high') _t3ModuleOpt = d.t3ModuleOpt;
    if (typeof d.showOrigPrice === 'boolean') _showOrigPrice = d.showOrigPrice;
    if (typeof d.showUpcTile === 'boolean') _showUpcTile = d.showUpcTile;
    if (d.favDisplayMode === 'customer' || d.favDisplayMode === 'user' || d.favDisplayMode === 'both') _favDisplayMode = d.favDisplayMode;
    if (typeof d.autoCreateFavCf === 'boolean') _autoCreateFavCf = d.autoCreateFavCf;
    if (VIEW_MODES.includes(d.defaultViewMode)) _defaultViewMode = d.defaultViewMode;
    if (typeof d.defaultSoDetailsExpanded === 'boolean') _defaultSoDetailsExpanded = d.defaultSoDetailsExpanded;
}

// Admin button handler — publish the current settings as the tenant-wide
// default. Shows a toast on success/failure and refreshes the
// "Last saved" line so the admin sees their action took effect.
function publishAdminDefaults() {
    if (!_isAdmin) {
        showToast('Only admins can publish defaults', 'error', 4000);
        return;
    }
    if (typeof saveReportData !== 'function') {
        showToast('saveReportData bridge unavailable — admin defaults need the Fishbowl host', 'error', 5000);
        return;
    }
    const ok = _saveAdminDefaults();
    if (ok) {
        showToast('Saved admin defaults for all users', 'success', 3000);
        renderAdminLastSaved();
        if (DEBUG) qoDebug('publishAdminDefaults → ' + JSON.stringify(_adminDefaults));
    } else {
        showToast('Could not save admin defaults — see console', 'error', 5000);
    }
}

// Show/hide the admin section in Settings + refresh the "Last saved"
// hint. Called once at init() after _isAdmin is known.
function applyAdminVisibility() {
    const sec = document.getElementById('adminDefaultsSection');
    if (sec) sec.style.display = _isAdmin ? '' : 'none';
    renderAdminLastSaved();
}

function renderAdminLastSaved() {
    const el = document.getElementById('adminDefaultsLastSaved');
    if (!el) return;
    if (_adminDefaults && _adminDefaults.savedAt) {
        const who = _adminDefaults.savedBy ? ` by ${escapeHtml(_adminDefaults.savedBy)}` : '';
        const when = typeof moment !== 'undefined' && moment(_adminDefaults.savedAt).isValid()
            ? moment(_adminDefaults.savedAt).fromNow() + ' (' + moment(_adminDefaults.savedAt).format(MOMENT_FMT) + ')'
            : _adminDefaults.savedAt;
        el.innerHTML = `Last published ${escapeHtml(when)}${who}.`;
    } else {
        el.textContent = 'Not yet published — falls back to user / built-in defaults.';
    }
}

function loadSavedState() {
    // Detect admin + read the report-level master blob first so per-user
    // values can selectively override individual keys. Both are silent
    // no-ops outside Fishbowl (bridges absent) — no harm in standalone.
    _isAdmin = _detectAdmin();
    _loadAdminDefaults();
    // Apply admin-master keys upfront. Per-user saved-state will overlay
    // these below where the user has set a value.
    _applyAdminDefaultsToState();
    try {
        const raw = _readSettings(SETTINGS_KEY);
        if (!raw) return;
        const s = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (s.v !== 1) return;
        // View mode is no longer restored as "last used" — it's driven by
        // the Default view SETTING (s.defaultViewMode), applied to
        // _viewMode by applySessionDefaults() once loading finishes. The
        // legacy s.viewMode key is deliberately ignored so the setting
        // isn't shadowed by whichever view the user last clicked.
        if (VIEW_MODES.includes(s.defaultViewMode)) _defaultViewMode = s.defaultViewMode;
        if (typeof s.defaultSoDetailsExpanded === 'boolean') {
            _defaultSoDetailsExpanded = s.defaultSoDetailsExpanded;
        }
        if (s.layoutPref === 'desktop' || s.layoutPref === 'auto') _layoutPref = s.layoutPref;
        _pageSize = s.pageSize || 24;
        // Migrate legacy sort values (saved before the field-dir refactor).
        const legacySort = {
            'name': 'name-asc',
            'num': 'num-asc',
            'last-purchased': 'last-purchased-desc',
        };
        _sortBy = legacySort[s.sortBy] || s.sortBy || 'num-asc';
        // Customer + despatch LG are deliberately NOT restored — every
        // session starts fresh so the rep picks the customer they're
        // working on now, and the despatch LG defaults from usertolg.
        _defaultStatusId = s.defaultStatusId || 20;
        _lazyImages = s.lazyImages !== false;
        if (typeof s.autoOpenSo === 'boolean') _autoOpenSo = s.autoOpenSo;
        if (s.t2ModuleOpt === 'high' || s.t2ModuleOpt === 'low') _t2ModuleOpt = s.t2ModuleOpt;
        if (s.t3ModuleOpt === 'high' || s.t3ModuleOpt === 'low') _t3ModuleOpt = s.t3ModuleOpt;
        if (typeof s.showOrigPrice === 'boolean') _showOrigPrice = s.showOrigPrice;
        if (typeof s.showUpcTile === 'boolean') _showUpcTile = s.showUpcTile;
        if (s.favDisplayMode === 'customer' || s.favDisplayMode === 'user' || s.favDisplayMode === 'both') _favDisplayMode = s.favDisplayMode;
        if (typeof s.autoCreateFavCf === 'boolean') _autoCreateFavCf = s.autoCreateFavCf;
        // Favourites — migration:
        //   v1 stored favourites as a Set<number productId> at s.favourites.
        //   v2 stores user favourites as a Set<string productNum> at
        //   s.userFavourites (and customer favourites live on the customer
        //   record, not in saved state). On first load after upgrade we
        //   keep the legacy numeric IDs and convert them to nums once
        //   products are loaded — see initialiseUserFavouritesFromLegacy.
        if (Array.isArray(s.userFavourites)) {
            _userFavourites = new Set(s.userFavourites.map(String).filter(Boolean));
        } else if (Array.isArray(s.favourites)) {
            // Stash the legacy IDs — they'll be converted to nums after
            // _allProducts loads (initialiseUserFavouritesFromLegacy).
            window._legacyFavouriteIds = s.favourites.map(n => parseInt(n, 10)).filter(n => !isNaN(n));
        }
        // Favourites filter — migration: v1 had a boolean favouritesOnly,
        // v2 has a tri-state favouritesMode (null|'customer'|'user').
        // Old `true` → 'user' (the closest analogue without a customer ref).
        if (typeof s.groupByPart === 'boolean') _groupByPart = s.groupByPart;
        if (typeof s.groupByTree === 'boolean') _groupByTree = s.groupByTree;
        if (typeof s.groupPreferredUOM === 'string') _groupPreferredUOM = s.groupPreferredUOM || 'ea';
        if (typeof s.favouriteWholePart === 'boolean') _favouriteWholePart = s.favouriteWholePart;
        if (typeof s.showDebug === 'boolean') DEBUG = s.showDebug;
        if (s.colWidths && typeof s.colWidths === 'object') {
            // Clamp any single column to <= 400px on load. The list
            // table now scales proportionally to fit the container, so
            // a previously-bloated saved width (e.g. accidentally
            // dragged to 1200px) would dominate the row's proportions
            // and squash every other column. 400px is enough for any
            // real-world content (descriptions ellipsis past that).
            _colWidths = {};
            for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(s.colWidths)) {
                const n = parseInt(v, 10);
                if (!isNaN(n) && n > 0) _colWidths[k] = Math.min(n, 400);
            }
            // One-time bump: the favourites column used to hold a single
            // star and defaulted to 28px. It now holds two side-by-side
            // toggles. Bump any saved width below 48 to the new floor
            // so existing users aren't stuck with cramped cells.
            if (_colWidths.fav != null && _colWidths.fav < 48) _colWidths.fav = 52;
        }
        // List-column order/visibility — saved entries keep their order;
        // columns added in later versions append (visible) at the end so
        // an old save never hides a new column silently.
        if (Array.isArray(s.listCols)) {
            const savedByKey = {};
            s.listCols.forEach(c => { if (c && c.key) savedByKey[c.key] = c; });
            const reordered = s.listCols
                .filter(c => c && LIST_COL_DEFS.some(d => d.key === c.key))
                .map(c => ({ key: c.key, vis: c.vis !== false }));
            const extras = LIST_COL_DEFS
                .filter(d => !savedByKey[d.key])
                .map(d => ({ key: d.key, vis: d.defVis !== false }));
            if (reordered.length) _listCols = [...reordered, ...extras];
        }
        if (s.filters) {
            // Search term is intentionally NOT restored — every session
            // starts with an empty search box so a stale SKU/keyword
            // filter doesn't silently hide the catalogue on load.
            _filters.search = '';
            _filters.previouslyPurchasedOnly = !!s.filters.previouslyPurchasedOnly;
            _filters.inStockOnly = !!s.filters.inStockOnly;
            // v3: 4-state ('customer'|'user'|'both'|null). v1: bool favouritesOnly
            if (s.filters.favouritesMode === 'customer'
                || s.filters.favouritesMode === 'user'
                || s.filters.favouritesMode === 'both') {
                _filters.favouritesMode = s.filters.favouritesMode;
            } else if (s.filters.favouritesOnly) {
                // Old saves had only a per-user list, so map to 'user'.
                _filters.favouritesMode = 'user';
            } else {
                _filters.favouritesMode = null;
            }
            _filters.activeOnly = s.filters.activeOnly !== false;
            if (Array.isArray(s.filters.productTreeIds)) {
                _filters.productTreeIds = new Set(s.filters.productTreeIds.map(String));
            }
            // Stock LG selection is intentionally NOT restored — every
            // session starts with all-LGs visible, matching customer +
            // despatch LG behaviour.
        }
        // A saved favourites-filter mode that the favourites display
        // setting no longer surfaces would filter on an invisible set —
        // coerce it to the closest visible equivalent (or off).
        coerceFavouritesFilterToDisplayMode();
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('loadSavedState failed:', e);
    }
}

// Seed the live session state from the persisted "default" settings.
// Called from init() AFTER loadSavedState so admin defaults + per-user
// overrides have both been resolved (loadSavedState can return early
// when the user has no saved blob, so this can't live inside it).
function applySessionDefaults() {
    _viewMode = VIEW_MODES.includes(_defaultViewMode) ? _defaultViewMode : 'list-plain';
    _soDetailsExpanded = !!_defaultSoDetailsExpanded;
}

let _pendingSelectedCustomerId = null;
let _pendingDespatchLgId = null;

function saveState() {
    const payload = {
        v: 1,
        // Customer + despatch LG are intentionally not persisted — see
        // matching note in loadSavedState. Each session re-prompts.
        // Persisted defaults (not last-used session state) — see
        // applySessionDefaults / loadSavedState.
        defaultViewMode: _defaultViewMode,
        defaultSoDetailsExpanded: _defaultSoDetailsExpanded,
        layoutPref: _layoutPref,
        pageSize: _pageSize,
        sortBy: _sortBy,
        defaultStatusId: _defaultStatusId,
        lazyImages: _lazyImages,
        autoOpenSo: _autoOpenSo,
        t2ModuleOpt: _t2ModuleOpt,
        t3ModuleOpt: _t3ModuleOpt,
        showOrigPrice: _showOrigPrice,
        showUpcTile: _showUpcTile,
        favDisplayMode: _favDisplayMode,
        autoCreateFavCf: _autoCreateFavCf,
        userFavourites: [..._userFavourites],
        groupByPart: _groupByPart,
        groupByTree: _groupByTree,
        groupPreferredUOM: _groupPreferredUOM,
        favouriteWholePart: _favouriteWholePart,
        showDebug: DEBUG,
        colWidths: _colWidths,
        listCols: _listCols.map(c => ({ key: c.key, vis: c.vis })),
        filters: {
            productTreeIds: [..._filters.productTreeIds],
            // locationGroupIds intentionally omitted — see loadSavedState
            search: _filters.search,
            previouslyPurchasedOnly: _filters.previouslyPurchasedOnly,
            inStockOnly: _filters.inStockOnly,
            favouritesMode: _filters.favouritesMode,
            activeOnly: _filters.activeOnly,
        },
        savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    try { _writeSettings(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload)); }
    catch (e) { console.warn('saveSettings failed:', e); }
}

async function resetSavedSettings() {
    const ok = await showConfirm({
        title: 'Reset saved settings?',
        body: `<p>Resets view mode, filters, favourites, column widths, and other saved Quick Order preferences for your account.</p><p style="color:var(--muted-2);font-size:11px;">Cart contents are not affected.</p>`,
        okLabel: 'Reset settings',
        danger: true,
    });
    if (!ok) return;
    _writeSettings(SETTINGS_KEY, '');
    location.reload();
}

// ── Debug console ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// In-app logger. Always writes to console.* (so devtools sees it too).
// When BI_SHOW_DEBUG=true, appends a styled line to the #qoDebugLog
// panel so reps can diagnose without devtools. Idempotent — safe to
// call before the DOM is ready.
function qoDebug(msg, kind) {
    const level = kind || 'info';
    const out = '[' + level.toUpperCase() + '] ' + msg;
    if (level === 'error')  console.error(out);
    else if (level === 'warn') console.warn(out);
    else                       console.log(out);
    const log = document.getElementById('qoDebugLog');
    if (!log) return;
    const ts = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'ln ' + level;
    line.innerHTML = '<span class="ts">' + ts + '</span>  ' + escapeHtml(msg);
    log.appendChild(line);
    // Cap at 500 lines to keep memory bounded
    while (log.children.length > 500) log.removeChild(log.firstChild);
    log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
}

// Wire the Hide/Show/Clear/Copy button handlers exactly once. Visibility
// of the console panel itself is driven by applyDebugVisibility().
let _debugWired = false;
function initDebugConsole() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('qoDebugConsole');
    if (!panel) return;
    if (_debugWired) { applyDebugVisibility(); return; }
    _debugWired = true;
    const log    = document.getElementById('qoDebugLog');
    const toggle = document.getElementById('qoDebugToggle');
    const clear  = document.getElementById('qoDebugClear');
    const copy   = document.getElementById('qoDebugCopy');
    if (toggle) toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const hidden = log.style.display === 'none';
        log.style.display = hidden ? '' : 'none';
        toggle.textContent = hidden ? 'Hide' : 'Show';
        // Sync the body padding so the cart-totals row re-anchors when
        // the log is collapsed/expanded.
        document.body.classList.toggle('qo-debug-open', hidden);
    });

    if (copy) copy.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const txt = Array.from(log.querySelectorAll('.ln')).map(n => n.textContent).join('\n');
        if (!txt) return;
        if (navigator.clipboard) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => showToast('Debug log copied', 'success', 2000));
        }
    });
    applyDebugVisibility();
}

// Show / hide the debug console without touching the wired-up button
// handlers. Safe to call any time DEBUG changes (e.g. when the user
// toggles the Settings checkbox).
function applyDebugVisibility() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('qoDebugConsole');
    if (!panel) return;
    if (DEBUG) {
        panel.classList.add('open');
        document.body.classList.add('qo-debug', 'qo-debug-open');
        qoDebug('Debug console enabled');
    } else {
        panel.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.classList.remove('qo-debug', 'qo-debug-open');
