// ── Toast (mirrors WO planner) ───────────────────────────────────────
function showToast(message, type = 'info', duration = 3000) {
    const container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = `toast ${type}`;
    const icon = type === 'success' ? '✓' : type === 'error' ? '✕' : 'ℹ';
    toast.innerHTML = `<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="text-lg">${icon}</span><span class="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">${message}</span></div>`;
    container.appendChild(toast);
    setTimeout(() => {
        toast.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
    }, duration);
}

// ── Confirmation modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// Replaces native confirm() so we can render rich content + match the
// rest of the design system. Returns a promise that resolves to true
// on OK, false on Cancel / Escape / backdrop click.
//
//   const ok = await showConfirm({ title, body, okLabel, danger });
//
// `body` is treated as HTML — escape user input before interpolation.
function showConfirm({ title = 'Confirm', body = '', okLabel = 'Confirm', cancelLabel = 'Cancel', danger = false } = {}) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('qoConfirmModal');
        if (!modal) {
            // JxBrowser renders window.confirm as a native (Java) dialog —
            // surface why we fell through so the rep can report it.
            if (typeof qoDebug === 'function') qoDebug('showConfirm: #qoConfirmModal missing — falling back to native confirm', 'error');
            resolve(window.confirm(title + '\n\n' + body.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')));
            return;
        }
        document.getElementById('qoConfirmTitle').textContent = title;
        document.getElementById('qoConfirmBody').innerHTML = body;
        const ok = document.getElementById('qoConfirmOk');
        const cancel = document.getElementById('qoConfirmCancel');
        const backdrop = modal.querySelector('.qo-modal-backdrop');
        ok.textContent = okLabel;
        cancel.textContent = cancelLabel;
        ok.className = 'hdr-btn ' + (danger ? 'danger' : 'primary');
        // Belt-and-braces: set inline styles in addition to the class so a
        // Tailwind utility or stacking-context quirk can't suppress the
        // modal. The class drives the popIn animation; the inline display
        // ensures the element is actually painted in JxBrowser.
        modal.classList.add('open');
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        if (typeof qoDebug === 'function') qoDebug('showConfirm: showing modal — ' + title);
        function done(v) {
            modal.classList.remove('open');
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            ok.removeEventListener('click', onOk);
            cancel.removeEventListener('click', onCancel);
            backdrop.removeEventListener('click', onCancel);
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
            resolve(v);
        }
        function onOk() { done(true); }
        function onCancel() { done(false); }
        function onKey(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); done(false); }
            else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); done(true); }
        }
        ok.addEventListener('click', onOk);
        cancel.addEventListener('click', onCancel);
        backdrop.addEventListener('click', onCancel);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        setTimeout(() => ok.focus(), 20);
    });
}

// ── Tooltip (price breakdown) ────────────────────────────────────────
let _tooltipTimer = null;
let _tooltipVisible = false;
function _positionTooltip(el, x, y) {
    const tw = 320, th = 200;
    // On phones the touch coords routinely place the tooltip
    // off-screen (especially when the user taps near the right edge).
    // Centre it on the viewport instead. Desktop keeps the
    // cursor-tracking placement.
    if (typeof isMobileViewport === 'function' && isMobileViewport()) {
        const vw = window.innerWidth;
        const vh = window.innerHeight;
        const w  = Math.min(tw, vw - 24);
        el.style.left  = Math.max(12, (vw - w) / 2) + 'px';
        el.style.top   = Math.max(12, (vh - th) / 2) + 'px';
        el.style.width = w + 'px';
        return;
    }
    el.style.width = '';
    const ax = (x + tw > window.innerWidth) ? x - tw - 15 : x + 15;
    const ay = (y + th > window.innerHeight) ? y - th - 15 : y + 15;
    el.style.left = ax + 'px';
    el.style.top  = ay + 'px';
}
function showTooltip(event, content) {
    const el = document.getElementById('qoTooltip');
    const x = event.pageX, y = event.pageY;
    if (_tooltipVisible) {
        el.innerHTML = content;
        _positionTooltip(el, x, y);
        return;
    }
    if (_tooltipTimer) clearTimeout(_tooltipTimer);
    _tooltipTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        el.innerHTML = content;
        _positionTooltip(el, x, y);
        el.classList.add('show');
        _tooltipVisible = true;
        _tooltipTimer = null;
    }, 400);
}
function hideTooltip() {
    if (_tooltipTimer) { clearTimeout(_tooltipTimer); _tooltipTimer = null; }
    const el = document.getElementById('qoTooltip');
    el.classList.remove('show');
    _tooltipVisible = false;
}

// ── Query helper (mirrors PO Summary qp/normalise pattern) ───────────
// Three transports, in priority order:
//   1. runQueryAsync — native bridge, desktop Fishbowl (JxBrowser).
//   2. runQuery      — sync sibling; fallback on older builds.
//   3. runRestApiAsync — present in the iOS / mobile app where the raw
//      SQL bridges aren't exposed. We hit /api/data-query through the
//      host's already-authenticated REST connection, so no login modal
//      is needed when running inside the mobile shell.
function lowercaseKeys(rows) {
    return (rows || []).map(r => {
        if (!r || typeof r !== 'object') return r;
        const out = {};
        for (const k of Object.keys(r)) out[k.toLowerCase()] = r[k];
        return out;
    });
}

async function qp(sql) {
    if (typeof runQueryAsync === 'function') {
        const r = await runQueryAsync(sql);
        return Array.isArray(r) ? r : (typeof r === 'string' ? JSON.parse(r) : []);
    }
    if (typeof runQuery === 'function') {
        const r = runQuery(sql);
        return typeof r === 'string' ? JSON.parse(r) : (Array.isArray(r) ? r : []);
    }
    if (typeof runRestApiAsync === 'function') {
        const raw = await runRestApiAsync({
            method: 'GET',
            path: '/api/data-query',
            queryParameters: [['query', sql]],
        });
        const data = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
        const rows = Array.isArray(data) ? data
            : (data && (data.rows || data.data || data.results)) || [];
        return lowercaseKeys(rows);
    }
    // Standalone — drive the REST API directly via fetch + Bearer token.
    return await standaloneQuery(sql);
}

// HTTP transport for /api/data-query.
//   - portal mode: same-origin fetch; Cloudflare Access cookie rides
//     along automatically (browser includes it for same-origin without
//     credentials: 'include' needed). No Bearer token from JS.
//   - standalone mode: cross-origin fetch with Bearer token.
async function standaloneQuery(sql) {
    if (MODE === 'standalone' && !_conn.token) {
        const err = new Error('Not connected — log in via the header Connect button.');
        err.code = 'NO_TOKEN';
        throw err;
    }
    const url = _conn.baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/api/data-query?query=' + encodeURIComponent(sql);
    const headers = {};
    if (_conn.token) headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + _conn.token;
    let res;
    try {
        res = await fetch(url, { headers });
    } catch (e) {
        // Network-layer failure (DNS, CORS, dropped TCP). In portal
        // mode that's typically the Pages Function being unreachable —
        // treat as server-down and start the recovery ping.
        if (MODE === 'portal') noteServerError();
        const err = new Error('Network error reaching ' + (_conn.baseUrl || location.origin)
            + '. Check the server URL and your network.');
        err.cause = e;
        throw err;
    }
    if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
        if (MODE === 'portal') {
            // 401/403 in portal mode = either Cloudflare Access kicked
            // us out OR the user's FB binding is broken (password
            // changed, KV entry deleted, etc.). Try to distinguish via
            // the response payload — if the server says needsLogin,
            // pop the connect modal in-place; if it doesn't, the
            // Access session itself has died, so a reload is the
            // right move (Access will re-OTP).
            let payload = null;
            try { payload = await res.clone().json(); } catch (_) {}
            if (payload && payload.needsLogin) {
                // Pre-fill with the active connection's tenantId +
                // username so a password-change re-auth is a one-field
                // type. Empty when there's nothing to fall back to.
                const c = _portalActiveConn;
                openFbConnectModal(c
                    ? { tenantId: c.tenantId, fbUsername: c.fbUsername, displayName: c.displayName }
                    : { firstRun: true });
                const err = new Error('Reconnect your Fishbowl account.');
                err.code = 'NEEDS_LOGIN';
                throw err;
            }
            const err = new Error('Portal access rejected the request ('
                + res.status + '). Your Cloudflare Access session may '
                + 'have expired. Try reloading the page.');
            err.code = 'AUTH_PORTAL';
            throw err;
        }
        _conn.token = null; persistConn(); updateConnPill();
        const err = new Error('Session expired — please log in again.');
        err.code = 'AUTH';
        throw err;
    }
    if (!res.ok) {
        // 5xx from the proxy = upstream FB is sick (server down,
        // tunnel down, or the cached token's logout call hung the
        // request). Surface as a server-status pill so the user
        // knows the page is paused, not broken.
        if (MODE === 'portal' && res.status >= 500) noteServerError();
        const txt = await res.text().catch(() => '');
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}${txt ? ' — ' + txt.slice(0, 200) : ''}`);
    }
    // Success — clear any prior server-unreachable banner.
    if (MODE === 'portal') noteServerOk();
    const data = await res.json();
    const rows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.rows || data.data || data.results || []);
    return lowercaseKeys(rows);
}

// Authenticate against /api/login. Returns the bearer token on success.
async function fbLogin(baseUrl, username, password, appName, appId) {
    const url = baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/api/login';
    let res;
    try {
        res = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ appName, appId: parseInt(appId, 10) || 102, username, password }),
        });
    } catch (e) {
        // Surface the underlying error verbatim — WKWebView typically
        // labels CORS failures distinctly ("Origin … is not allowed by
        // Access-Control-Allow-Origin" or "Preflight response is not
        // successful"). This is the key signal for whether the FB
        // server is reachable but rejecting cross-origin, vs truly
        // unreachable.
        const detail = (e && (e.message || e.name)) || String(e);
        throw new Error('Fetch to ' + url + ' failed: ' + detail
            + ' — usually means CORS rejected the preflight (FB server '
            + 'doesn\'t send Access-Control-Allow-* headers) or the host '
            + 'is unreachable from this device.');
    }
    const txt = await res.text();
    let parsed = null;
    try { parsed = JSON.parse(txt); } catch (_) {}
    if (res.status === 401 && parsed && /approval/i.test(parsed.message || parsed.Message || '')) {
        throw new Error('App "' + appName + '" registered but not yet approved. An admin must approve it in '
            + 'Fishbowl → Maintenance → Integrated Applications.');
    }
    if (!res.ok) {
        const msg = (parsed && (parsed.message || parsed.Message || parsed.error)) || txt || ('HTTP ' + res.status);
        throw new Error(msg);
    }
    const tok = parsed && (parsed.token || parsed.Token || parsed.access_token);
    if (!tok) throw new Error('Login OK but no token field in the response.');
    return tok;
}

// ── Standalone connect UI handlers ───────────────────────────────────
function updateConnPill() {
    const pill  = document.getElementById('qoConnPill');
    const label = document.getElementById('qoConnPillLabel');
    if (!pill) return;
    if (MODE === 'portal') {
        // Pill primary label = company name from the active connection
        // (captured at /connect time from FB's `company.name`). Falls
        // back to the admin-set tenantName, then the Access email.
        // Clicking the pill opens a small dropdown of all known
        // connections + "connect another tenant" / "sign out" actions.
        pill.style.display = 'inline-flex';
        pill.classList.remove('error');
        pill.classList.add('connected');
        pill.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        pill.onclick = togglePortalMenu;
        const c = _portalActiveConn;
        if (label) {
            label.textContent = c
                ? (c.companyName || c.tenantName || c.fbUsername)
                : (_portalIdentityEmail || 'Signed in');
        }
        const sub = c
            ? c.displayName + (_portalIdentityEmail ? ' (' + _portalIdentityEmail + ')' : '')
            : (_portalIdentityEmail || '');
        pill.title = c
            ? 'Active: ' + (c.companyName || c.tenantName || c.fbUsername)
              + '\nSigned in as ' + sub + '\nClick to switch tenant or connect another.'
            : 'Signed in via Cloudflare Access' + (_portalIdentityEmail ? ' as ' + _portalIdentityEmail : '');
        return;
    }
    if (MODE !== 'standalone') { pill.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    pill.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    pill.classList.remove('connected', 'error');
    if (_conn.token) {
        pill.classList.add('connected');
        const host = String(_conn.baseUrl).replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
        if (label) label.textContent = host || 'Connected';
        pill.title = `Connected to ${_conn.baseUrl} as ${_conn.username || '?'} — click to reconnect`;
    } else {
        if (label) label.textContent = 'Connect…';
        pill.title = 'Not connected — click to log in to Fishbowl';
    }
}

// Portal-mode identity + tenant state. Populated by loadPortalIdentity():
//   _portalIdentityEmail  — Cloudflare Access email
//   _portalConnections    — array of { tenantId, tenantName, companyName,
//                                       fbUsername, displayName, connectedAt }
//   _portalActiveTenantId — tenantId of the currently-active connection
//   _portalActiveConn     — pointer into _portalConnections for the active one
let _portalIdentityEmail   = null;
let _portalConnections     = [];
let _portalActiveTenantId  = null;
let _portalActiveConn      = null;

function _findConn(tenantId) {
    return _portalConnections.find(c => c.tenantId === tenantId) || null;
}

async function loadPortalIdentity() {
    if (MODE !== 'portal') return;
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/_internal/whoami', {
            headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
        });
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();
        _portalIdentityEmail  = data.email || null;
        _portalConnections    = Array.isArray(data.connections) ? data.connections : [];
        _portalActiveTenantId = data.activeTenantId || null;
        _portalActiveConn     = _findConn(_portalActiveTenantId) || _portalConnections[0] || null;
        if (data.needsLogin || _portalConnections.length === 0) {
            updateConnPill();
            openFbConnectModal({ firstRun: true });
            return false;
        }
        updateConnPill();
        return true;
    } catch (_) {
        // Identity probe failures are non-fatal; any 403 from the proxy
        // will trigger the connect modal via the standalone-query
        // error path.
    }
}

// ── FB connect modal (portal mode) ─────────────────────────────────
// opts.firstRun     — true when this is the user's first-ever connect;
//                     hides the Cancel button (no prior connection to
//                     return to).
// opts.tenantId     — pre-fill the tenant code (used when re-entering
//                     creds after an FB password change).
// opts.fbUsername   — pre-fill username (likewise).
// opts.displayName  — pre-fill display name.
function openFbConnectModal(opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const modal = document.getElementById('qoFbConnectModal');
    if (!modal) return;
    document.getElementById('qoFbConnectEmail').textContent =
        _portalIdentityEmail || '(unknown)';
    document.getElementById('qoFbConnectError').classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('qoFbConnTenant').value  = opts.tenantId    || '';
    document.getElementById('qoFbConnUser').value    = opts.fbUsername  || '';
    document.getElementById('qoFbConnPass').value    = '';
    document.getElementById('qoFbConnDisplay').value = opts.displayName || '';
    // Cancel button only available when the user has at least one
    // existing connection to fall back to.
    document.getElementById('qoFbConnCancel').style.display =
        (opts.firstRun || _portalConnections.length === 0) ? 'none' : '';
    modal.classList.add('open');
    setTimeout(() => {
        const focusEl = opts.tenantId
            ? document.getElementById('qoFbConnUser')
            : document.getElementById('qoFbConnTenant');
        focusEl && focusEl.focus();
    }, 30);
    // Hide the catalogue when this is a first-run / no-fallback modal —
    // the data can't load yet anyway, and an empty grid looks broken.
    if (opts.firstRun || _portalConnections.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('productHost').innerHTML = '';
        document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent = 'Connect your Fishbowl account to load data.';
    }
}
function closeFbConnectModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('qoFbConnectModal');
    if (modal) modal.classList.remove('open');
}
function closeFbConnectModalAndContinue() {
    // Cancel button — only exposed when there's already an active
    // connection, so dismissing the modal just returns the user to
    // their current tenant. No reload needed.
    closeFbConnectModal();
}

async function submitFbConnect() {
    const tenantId    = document.getElementById('qoFbConnTenant').value.trim();
    const fbUsername  = document.getElementById('qoFbConnUser').value.trim();
    const fbPassword  = document.getElementById('qoFbConnPass').value;
    const displayName = document.getElementById('qoFbConnDisplay').value.trim();
    const errEl       = document.getElementById('qoFbConnectError');
    const btn         = document.getElementById('qoFbConnSubmit');
    errEl.classList.remove('show');
    if (!tenantId || !fbUsername || !fbPassword) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Tenant code, Fishbowl username, and password are all required.';
        errEl.classList.add('show');
        return;
    }
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = 'Connecting…';
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/_internal/connect', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ tenantId, fbUsername, fbPassword, displayName }),
        });
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!res.ok) {
            errEl.textContent = (data && (data.error || data.detail)) || ('HTTP ' + res.status);
            errEl.classList.add('show');
            return;
        }
        closeFbConnectModal();
        showToast('Connected to ' + (data.connection?.companyName || data.connection?.tenantName || 'Fishbowl'), 'success', 3000);
        // Reload so loadPortalIdentity + bootstrapData run cleanly with
        // the new active tenant. Cheaper than threading the new state
        // through every cart / cache reset path.
        location.reload();
    } catch (e) {
        errEl.textContent = (e && e.message) || String(e);
        errEl.classList.add('show');
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'Connect';
    }
}

// "Sign out" — ends the session, KEEPS the account.
//
// This used to POST /api/_internal/disconnect, which deletes the whole KV
// record: signing out forgot the tenant code, username and password, so
// every return trip meant re-entering all three. Signing out and forgetting
// an account are different intentions.
//
// end-session releases the Fishbowl session behind the connection (so the
// seat is freed and nothing runs on a cached token) and leaves the stored
// credentials alone. Forgetting an account stays a separate, confirmed
// action — the ✕ on a tenant row, disconnectTenant().
//
// Best-effort: an older Worker without this route answers 404, and the
// Access logout below must happen regardless. Signing out can never be
// blocked by a server-side failure.
async function fbConnectLogout() {
    try { await fetch('/api/_internal/end-session', { method: 'POST' }); }
    catch (_) { /* older deployed Worker 404s this — the Access logout must
                   still happen, so never let it block */ }
    await logoutAccess();
}

// Render and toggle the tenant menu (dropdown anchored under the
// conn-pill). Shows each connected tenant (highlight active), plus
// actions to connect another tenant or sign out entirely.
function renderPortalMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('qoPortalMenu');
    if (!menu) return;
    const conns = _portalConnections || [];
    const checkSvg = '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>';
    const xSvg     = '<svg width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg>';
    let html = '<div class="menu-section-label">Active connection</div>';
    if (conns.length === 0) {
        html += '<div class="menu-item"><div class="info"><div class="title">No active connection</div></div></div>';
    } else {
        for (const c of conns) {
            const active = c.tenantId === _portalActiveTenantId;
            const safeId = escapeHtml(c.tenantId);
            html += `
                <div class="menu-item${active ? ' active' : ''}" data-switch-tenant="${safeId}">
                    <span class="check">${active ? checkSvg : ''}</span>
                    <div class="info">
                        <div class="title">${escapeHtml(c.companyName || c.tenantName || c.tenantId)}</div>
                        <div class="sub">${escapeHtml(c.displayName || c.fbUsername)} @ ${escapeHtml(c.tenantId)}</div>
                    </div>
                    ${conns.length > 1 ? `<button class="disconnect" data-disconnect-tenant="${safeId}" title="Disconnect this tenant" aria-label="Disconnect">${xSvg}</button>` : ''}
                </div>`;
        }
    }
    html += '<div class="menu-divider"></div>';
    html += '<div class="menu-item menu-action" data-action="connect-new">+ Connect another tenant</div>';
    html += '<div class="menu-divider"></div>';
    // Sign out ends the session only. Removing an account is the ✕ on its
    // row — spelled out here because the two used to be the same thing.
    html += '<div class="menu-item menu-action danger" data-action="signout">'
          + '<div class="info"><div class="title">Sign out</div>'
          + '<div class="sub">Keeps your saved connection</div></div></div>';
    if (_portalIdentityEmail) {
        html += `<div class="menu-meta">Cloudflare Access: ${escapeHtml(_portalIdentityEmail)}</div>`;
    }
    menu.innerHTML = html;
    // Wire up click handlers (delegate from the container; per-item
    // listeners would multiply on every re-render).
    menu.onclick = (e) => {
        const t = e.target.closest('[data-disconnect-tenant]');
        if (t) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            closePortalMenu();
            disconnectTenant(t.dataset.disconnectTenant);
            return;
        }
        const s = e.target.closest('[data-switch-tenant]');
        if (s) {
            closePortalMenu();
            switchTenant(s.dataset.switchTenant);
            return;
        }

// ── Server reachability monitoring (portal mode) ───────────────────
// Tracks whether the FB server (behind the tunnel) is responding.
// API calls report their outcome via noteServerError() / noteServerOk();
// when in failure state, a pill appears in the header and a 15-second
// ping retries `SELECT 1` until the server is back. Lightweight — one
// KV + DO + tunnel round trip per ping.
const SERVER_PING_MS = 15000;
let _serverStatus = 'ok';           // 'ok' | 'unreachable' | 'reconnecting'
let _serverPingTimer = null;
let _serverPingInFlight = false;

function noteServerError() {
    if (_serverStatus === 'unreachable' || _serverStatus === 'reconnecting') return;
    _serverStatus = 'unreachable';
    renderServerStatusPill();
    startServerPing();
}

function noteServerOk() {
    if (_serverStatus === 'ok') return;
    const wasFailing = _serverStatus !== 'ok';
    _serverStatus = 'ok';
    renderServerStatusPill();
    stopServerPing();
    // Auto-reload data on recovery — addresses + customers may have
    // become stale during the outage.
    if (wasFailing && typeof bootstrapData === 'function') {
        showToast('Reconnected to Fishbowl', 'success', 2500);
        bootstrapData();
    }
}

function startServerPing() {
    if (_serverPingTimer || MODE !== 'portal') return;
    _serverPingTimer = setInterval(serverPingNow, SERVER_PING_MS);
}
function stopServerPing() {
    if (_serverPingTimer) { clearInterval(_serverPingTimer); _serverPingTimer = null; }
}

async function serverPingNow() {
    if (_serverPingInFlight || MODE !== 'portal') return;
    _serverPingInFlight = true;
    _serverStatus = 'reconnecting';
    renderServerStatusPill();
    try {
        // Lightweight FB query — exercises the full chain (Function →
        // Worker → DO token → tunnel → FB) without hitting an expensive
        // table. SELECT 1 is fast on every Fishbowl version.
        const res = await fetch('/api/data-query?query=' + encodeURIComponent('SELECT 1 AS ok'), {
            headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
        });
        if (res.ok) { noteServerOk(); return; }
        // Still failing — flip back to "unreachable" so the dot stops
        // pulsing as "reconnecting" until the next interval fire.
        _serverStatus = 'unreachable';
        renderServerStatusPill();
    } catch (_) {
        _serverStatus = 'unreachable';
        renderServerStatusPill();
    } finally {
        _serverPingInFlight = false;
    }
}

function renderServerStatusPill() {
    let pill = document.getElementById('qoServerStatusPill');
    if (_serverStatus === 'ok') {
        if (pill) pill.remove();
        return;
    }
    if (!pill) {
        pill = document.createElement('span');
        pill.id = 'qoServerStatusPill';
        pill.className = 'server-status-pill';
        // Insert before the user/connect pill so it reads left-to-right
        // as "problem indicator → user".
        const userPill = document.getElementById('qoConnPill');
        if (userPill && userPill.parentNode) {
            userPill.parentNode.insertBefore(pill, userPill);
        } else {
            document.body.appendChild(pill);
        }
    }
    pill.classList.toggle('reconnecting', _serverStatus === 'reconnecting');
    const label = _serverStatus === 'reconnecting'
        ? 'Reconnecting…'
        : 'Fishbowl unreachable';
    pill.innerHTML =
        '<span class="status-dot"></span>' +
        '<span class="status-text">' + label + '</span>' +
        '<button class="status-retry" onclick="serverPingNow()" type="button" title="Retry now" aria-label="Retry">↻</button>';
}

// ── Idle timeout (portal mode) ─────────────────────────────────────
// Cloudflare Access sessions last 24h by default but we want a tighter
// idle timeout so a left-open browser doesn't keep the FB connection
// available indefinitely. After IDLE_LIMIT_MS of no user activity we
// redirect to /cdn-cgi/access/logout, which clears the Access JWT
// cookie and forces a fresh OTP on next visit.
//
// The remaining time is shown in the header next to the email. Clicking
// the time extends the session (resets the timer). Clicking the power
// icon logs out immediately.
const IDLE_LIMIT_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;  // 10 minutes
const IDLE_SHOW_MS  = 2 * 60 * 1000;   // show countdown when remaining < 2 min
let _idleLastActivity = Date.now();
let _idleTicker = null;
function recordActivity() { _idleLastActivity = Date.now(); }
function extendIdle() { recordActivity(); updateIdlePill(); }
// Raw primitive: drop the Cloudflare Access cookie. Prefer fbConnectLogout(),
// which also releases the Fishbowl session first. Neither touches the stored
// tenant credentials.
const ACCESS_LOGOUT_PATH = '/cdn-cgi/access/logout';

// Set true to end the whole Cloudflare Access session rather than just this
// app's. The trade is the landing page — see the note below.
const FULL_ACCESS_LOGOUT = false;

// Raw primitive: ends the Cloudflare Access session. Callers who want the
// Fishbowl session released too should call fbConnectLogout() instead.
//
// Cloudflare's logout endpoint has no returnTo parameter — navigating to it
// dumps the user on a generic Cloudflare "you have been logged out" page with
// no way back to the app. Fetching it instead clears the app's
// CF_Authorization cookie (same-origin, so the Set-Cookie applies) and leaves
// us in control of where to go next: back to this page, where Access finds no
// cookie and serves its login screen.
//
// Caveat: that clears the APP cookie only. If the user's global Access/IdP
// session is still live, Access re-issues a token silently and they land back
// in the app instead of at a login form. Ending that as well means navigating
// to <team>.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/logout, which is cross-origin
// and so cannot be fetched — only navigated to, which is exactly what costs
// the redirect. FULL_ACCESS_LOGOUT picks that trade instead.
async function logoutAccess() {
    if (MODE !== 'portal' || FULL_ACCESS_LOGOUT) {
        location.href = ACCESS_LOGOUT_PATH;
        return;
    }
    let cleared = false;
    try {
        const r = await fetch(ACCESS_LOGOUT_PATH, { credentials: 'include', cache: 'no-store' });
        cleared = r.ok;
    } catch (_) { /* handled below */ }
    // Never silently stay signed in. If clearing the cookie did not
    // demonstrably work, reloading would leave the user logged in having just
    // clicked Sign out — so fall back to navigating. Cloudflare's page is a
    // worse landing spot than the login form, but it is an actual sign-out.
    if (cleared) location.replace(location.pathname + location.search);
    else location.href = ACCESS_LOGOUT_PATH;
}
function updateIdlePill() {
    const pill = document.getElementById('qoIdlePill');
    const cd   = document.getElementById('qoIdleCountdown');
    if (!pill || !cd) return;
    if (MODE !== 'portal') { pill.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    const remaining = Math.max(0, IDLE_LIMIT_MS - (Date.now() - _idleLastActivity));
    if (remaining <= 0) {
        pill.style.display = 'none';
        // Timing out is still a sign-out: release the Fishbowl session, keep
        // the saved connection so the user just re-authenticates on return.
        fbConnectLogout();
        return;
    }
    // Hide entirely until we're inside the "about to log out" window.
    // Activity resets the timer, which pushes remaining back above this
    // threshold and re-hides the pill on the next tick — exactly what
    // we want: the header is clean during normal use, and the
    // countdown only appears when the user might actually be about to
    // be logged out.
    if (remaining > IDLE_SHOW_MS) {
        pill.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    pill.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    const mins = Math.floor(remaining / 60000);
    const secs = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000);
    cd.textContent = mins + ':' + String(secs).padStart(2, '0');
    pill.classList.remove('warn', 'alert');
    if (remaining < 15 * 1000) pill.classList.add('alert');
    else if (remaining < 60 * 1000) pill.classList.add('warn');
}
function enableIdleTimer() {
    if (MODE !== 'portal') return;
    // Reset on any meaningful interaction. `passive: true` so scrolling
    // doesn't trigger jank, even on long pages.
    ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll'].forEach(evt => {
        window.addEventListener(evt, recordActivity, { passive: true });
    });
    // Tick every second so the countdown reads as live.
    if (_idleTicker) clearInterval(_idleTicker);
    _idleTicker = setInterval(updateIdlePill, 1000);
    updateIdlePill();
}

async function submitLogin() {
    const baseUrl  = document.getElementById('qoConnBaseUrl').value.trim();
    const username = document.getElementById('qoConnUser').value.trim();
    const password = document.getElementById('qoConnPass').value;
    const appName  = document.getElementById('qoConnAppName').value.trim() || 'Quick Order';
    const appId    = parseInt(document.getElementById('qoConnAppId').value, 10) || 102;
    const errEl    = document.getElementById('qoLoginError');
    const btn      = document.getElementById('qoConnSubmit');
    errEl.classList.remove('show');
    if (!baseUrl || !username || !password) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Server URL, username, and password are required.';
        errEl.classList.add('show');
        return;
    }
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = 'Logging in…';
    try {
        const tok = await fbLogin(baseUrl, username, password, appName, appId);
        _conn.baseUrl = baseUrl;
        _conn.username = username;
        _conn.appName = appName;
        _conn.appId = appId;
        _conn.token = tok;
        persistConn();
        updateConnPill();
        closeConnModal();
        showToast('Connected to ' + baseUrl, 'success', 3000);
        // First successful login of the session — kick off the data
        // loads init() would normally fire after the bridge check.
        if (typeof bootstrapData === 'function') bootstrapData();
    } catch (e) {
        errEl.textContent = e.message || String(e);
        errEl.classList.add('show');
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'Log In';
    }
}

// ── Currency formatting ──────────────────────────────────────────────
let _currencyLocale = { locale: 'en-US', symbol: '$' };
function loadCurrency() {
    try { if (typeof currencyLocale === 'function') _currencyLocale = currencyLocale(); }
    catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
}
// Currency formatting — mirrors PurchaseOrderSummary.htm L457. Building
// the string manually (symbol + toLocaleString grouping) avoids Intl's
// hard requirement for a `currency: 'USD'` etc. code, which would force
// the wrong symbol when home currency isn't USD.
function fmtMoney(amount) {
    if (amount == null || isNaN(amount)) return '—';
    const sym = _currencyLocale.symbol || '$';
    const loc = _currencyLocale.locale || 'en-US';
    const n = parseFloat(amount);
    const neg = n < 0;
    const abs = Math.abs(n);
    return (neg ? '-' : '') + sym + abs.toLocaleString(loc, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}

// ── Multi-select primitive (ported from PO Summary 739–836) ──────────
// Single-select variant uses `_singleSelect: true` in the data object.
// Display label for a customer. Sub-customers (customer.parentId set)
// render as "Parent Customer > Customer" so same-named records under
// different parents are naturally distinguishable — they can carry
// different group memberships and therefore price differently. If the
// FULL label is still ambiguous (true duplicate records), the customer
// number is appended as a last resort.
function customerBaseLabel(c) {
    if (!c) return '';
    return c.parentName ? `${c.parentName} > ${c.name}` : c.name;
}
function customerLabel(c) {
    if (!c) return '';
    const base = customerBaseLabel(c);
    return _duplicateCustomerNames.has(base) ? `${base} (#${c.num})` : base;
}
let _duplicateCustomerNames = new Set();   // ambiguous BASE labels; rebuilt in loadCustomers

function msData(type) {
    switch (type) {
        case 'cust':
            return { list: _customers.map(c => ({ val: String(c.id), lbl: customerLabel(c), sub: c.number })),
                     sel: new Set(_selectedCustomer ? [String(_selectedCustomer.id)] : []),
                     ph: 'Select customer…', single: true, field: 'Customer' };
        case 'tree':
            return { list: _productTrees.map(t => ({ val: String(t.id), lbl: t.name })),
                     sel: _filters.productTreeIds, ph: 'All categories', single: false, field: 'Category' };
        case 'lg':
            return { list: _locationGroups.map(g => ({ val: String(g.id), lbl: g.name })),
                     sel: _filters.locationGroupIds, ph: 'All location groups', single: false, field: 'Stock LG' };
        case 'despatchLg':
            return { list: _locationGroups.map(g => ({ val: String(g.id), lbl: g.name })),
                     sel: new Set(_despatchLg ? [String(_despatchLg.id)] : []),
                     ph: 'Default location group', single: true, field: 'Order LG' };
    }
}

function buildMS(type) {
    const trig = document.getElementById(type + 'Trigger');
    if (!trig) return;
    updateMSTrigger(type);
    trig.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleMS(type); };
    const dd = document.getElementById(type + 'Dropdown');
    if (dd) dd.onclick = (e) => e.stopPropagation();
    const search = document.getElementById(type + 'Search');
    if (search) search.oninput = (e) => renderMSList(type, e.target.value);
    const all = document.getElementById(type + 'All');
    if (all) all.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const d = msData(type); d.list.forEach(it => d.sel.add(it.val));
        updateMSTrigger(type); renderMSList(type, search ? search.value : '');
        if (type === 'tree' || type === 'lg') applyAllFilters();
    };
    const clr = document.getElementById(type + 'Clear');
    if (clr) clr.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        msData(type).sel.clear();
        updateMSTrigger(type); renderMSList(type, search ? search.value : '');
        if (type === 'tree' || type === 'lg') applyAllFilters();
    };
}

// `display:block` on phone (where the trigger collapses to a 36px
// round icon button). Keeping these inline so the entire trigger
// HTML is re-set by updateMSTrigger() without external deps.
const MS_ICONS = {
    tree: '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 7a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2 2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V7z"/></svg>',
    lg:   '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 16V8a2 2 0 0 0-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 0 0-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 0 0 3 8v8a2 2 0 0 0 1 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 0 0 2 0l7-4A2 2 0 0 0 21 16z"/><polyline points="3.27 6.96 12 12.01 20.73 6.96"/><line x1="12" y1="22.08" x2="12" y2="12"/></svg>',
    despatchLg: '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="1" y="3" width="15" height="13"/><polygon points="16 8 20 8 23 11 23 16 16 16 16 8"/><circle cx="5.5" cy="18.5" r="2.5"/><circle cx="18.5" cy="18.5" r="2.5"/></svg>',
    cust: '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>',
};

function updateMSTrigger(type) {
    const trig = document.getElementById(type + 'Trigger');
    if (!trig) return;
    const d = msData(type);
    // Inline triggers (those inside #filterChipStrip) get:
    //   - a small uppercase field label (desktop) and
    //   - an icon glyph (mobile only — shown via CSS at <640px)
    // CSS toggles which is visible at each breakpoint.
    const isInline = !!trig.closest('#filterChipStrip');
    const iconHtml  = (isInline && MS_ICONS[type]) ? `<span class="ms-icon">${MS_ICONS[type]}</span>` : '';
    const labelHtml = (isInline && d.field) ? `<span class="ms-field-label">${d.field}</span>` : '';
    // Active-filter dot — shown next to the icon on mobile when this
    // selector has at least one filter applied. CSS positions it.
    const activeDot = (isInline && d.sel.size > 0) ? '<span class="ms-active-dot"></span>' : '';
    if (d.sel.size === 0) {
        trig.innerHTML = `${iconHtml}${activeDot}${labelHtml}<span class="ms-placeholder">${d.ph}</span><span style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:10px;margin-left:auto;">▾</span>`;
        return;
    }
    // Category tree: the selection Set holds cascaded descendant ids, so
    // the flat-tag rendering below would spam dozens of tags. Show only
    // the "top" selected nodes (a selected node whose parent isn't
    // selected) as tags instead.
    if (type === 'tree') {
        const tops = selectedTreeTops();
        const tags = tops.slice(0, 3).map(n => `<span class="ms-tag">${escapeHtml(n.name)}</span>`);
        if (tops.length > 3) tags.push(`<span class="ms-tag">+${tops.length - 3}</span>`);
        trig.innerHTML = iconHtml + activeDot + labelHtml + tags.join('') + '<span style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:10px;margin-left:auto;">▾</span>';
        return;
    }
    if (d.single) {
        const v = [...d.sel][0];
        const item = d.list.find(it => it.val === v);
        const label = item ? item.lbl : v;
        trig.innerHTML = `${iconHtml}${activeDot}${labelHtml}<span class="ms-tag">${label}</span><span style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:10px;margin-left:auto;">▾</span>`;
        return;
    }
    const tags = [];
    let shown = 0;
    for (const item of d.list) {
        if (!d.sel.has(item.val)) continue;
        if (shown < 3) {
            tags.push(`<span class="ms-tag">${item.lbl}<span class="ms-tag-x" data-type="${type}" data-val="${String(item.val).replace(/"/g,'"')}">×</span></span>`);
        }
        shown++;
    }
    if (shown > 3) tags.push(`<span class="ms-tag">+${shown - 3}</span>`);
    trig.innerHTML = iconHtml + activeDot + labelHtml + tags.join('') + '<span style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:10px;margin-left:auto;">▾</span>';
    trig.querySelectorAll('.ms-tag-x').forEach(x => {
        x.onclick = (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            const t = x.dataset.type, v = x.dataset.val;
            msData(t).sel.delete(v);
            updateMSTrigger(t);
        };
    });
}

function renderMSList(type, search) {
    const listEl = document.getElementById(type + 'List');
    if (!listEl) return;
    // Category filter renders as a nested folder tree with cascade
    // selection, not a flat checkbox list.
    if (type === 'tree') { renderTreeFilterList(listEl, search); return; }
    const d = msData(type);
    const term = (search || '').toLowerCase();
    const filtered = d.list.filter(it => {
        if (!term) return true;
        return (it.lbl || '').toLowerCase().includes(term)
            || String(it.val).toLowerCase().includes(term)
            || (it.sub || '').toLowerCase().includes(term);
    });
    if (!filtered.length) {
        listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ms-empty">No matches</div>';
        return;
    }
    listEl.innerHTML = filtered.map(it => {
        const selected = d.sel.has(it.val);
        const sub = it.sub ? `<span class="sub"> · ${it.sub}</span>` : '';
        const checkbox = d.single ? '' : `<input type="checkbox" data-type="${type}" data-val="${String(it.val).replace(/"/g,'"')}" ${selected ? 'checked' : ''}>`;
        return `<label class="ms-item${selected ? ' selected' : ''}" data-val="${String(it.val).replace(/"/g,'"')}" data-type="${type}">${checkbox}<span>${it.lbl}${sub}</span></label>`;
    }).join('');
    if (d.single) {
        listEl.querySelectorAll('.ms-item').forEach(item => {
            item.onclick = () => {
                d.sel.clear();
                d.sel.add(item.dataset.val);
                updateMSTrigger(type);
                onSingleSelectChange(type, item.dataset.val);
                closeMS();
            };
        });
    } else {
        listEl.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb => {
            cb.onchange = () => {
                const t = cb.dataset.type, v = cb.dataset.val;
                const dd = msData(t);
                if (cb.checked) dd.sel.add(v); else dd.sel.delete(v);
                updateMSTrigger(t);
                // Re-apply live so the catalogue reflects the change
                // without needing to close the dropdown (the historical
                // bug: filters never re-ran on multi-select change).
                if (t === 'tree' || t === 'lg') applyAllFilters();
            };
        });
    }
}

function toggleMS(type) {
    const dd = document.getElementById(type + 'Dropdown');
    if (!dd) return;
    if (_activeMS === type) { closeMS(); return; }
    closeMS();
    _activeMS = type;
    dd.classList.remove('hidden');
    renderMSList(type, '');
    const search = document.getElementById(type + 'Search');
    if (search) { search.value = ''; setTimeout(() => search.focus(), 10); }
}

// Single-select callback (customer + despatch LG pickers).
function onSingleSelectChange(type, val) {
    if (type === 'cust') {
        const id = parseInt(val, 10);
        selectCustomer(_customers.find(c => c.id === id));
    } else if (type === 'despatchLg') {
        const id = parseInt(val, 10);
        const lg = _locationGroups.find(g => g.id === id);
        _despatchLg = lg ? { id: lg.id, name: lg.name } : null;
        saveState();
        // Refresh the trigger AFTER _despatchLg is updated — msData()
        // rebuilds its Set from _despatchLg on every call, so the
        // updateMSTrigger() invoked by the click handler ran against
        // the OLD value. Without this second call the trigger keeps
        // showing the previous selection (one option behind).
        updateMSTrigger('despatchLg');
        renderStatusLine();
    }
}

// Resolve the current user's default LG from usertolg (defaultFlag=1).
// Called once in init() after _locationGroups + getUser() are available.
// Falls back to the first available LG so the despatch field is never
// empty when the customer has no default mapped.
async function loadDefaultDispatchLg() {
    // Honour a persisted choice first — _pendingDespatchLgId is set in
    // loadSavedState() before the LG list is available.
    if (_pendingDespatchLgId != null) {
        const saved = _locationGroups.find(g => g.id === _pendingDespatchLgId);
        if (saved) { _despatchLg = { id: saved.id, name: saved.name }; }
        _pendingDespatchLgId = null;
        if (_despatchLg) return;
    }
    try {
        if (typeof getUser === 'function') {
            const user = JSON.parse(getUser());
            if (user && user.id) {
                const rows = await qp(`
                    SELECT u2lg.locationgroupid AS id, lg.name AS name
                    FROM usertolg u2lg
                    INNER JOIN locationgroup lg ON lg.id = u2lg.locationgroupid
                    WHERE u2lg.userid = ${parseInt(user.id, 10)}
                      AND u2lg.defaultFlag = 1
                    LIMIT 1
                `);
                if (rows.length) {
                    _despatchLg = { id: rows[0].id, name: rows[0].name };
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('loadDefaultDispatchLg failed:', e); }
    // Last resort — use the first active LG so submission can still proceed.
    if (_locationGroups.length) {
        _despatchLg = { id: _locationGroups[0].id, name: _locationGroups[0].name };
    }
}

function renderStatusLine() {
    const el = document.getElementById('statusLine');
    if (!el) return;
    // The Orders view has its own summary. #statusLine is inside
    // .hdr-title-block, which is display:none on a phone, so the orders
    // toolbar carries a duplicate line fed by the same builder.
    if (_appView === 'orders') {
        el.innerHTML = ordersStatusText();
        const dup = document.getElementById('ordersStatusLine');
        if (dup) dup.innerHTML = ordersStatusText();
        return;
    }
    const parts = [];
    // Plain read-only text, and only when a customer is selected. This
    // used to be a blue, dotted-underlined, ▾-suffixed span that opened
    // the customer picker on click — it read as a dropdown sitting in
    // the page title, which is confusing and redundant with the real
    // Customer picker in the filter strip. The status line just reports
    // state now; use the filter strip (or, on phone, the header
    // trigger) to change customer.
    if (_selectedCustomer) {
        parts.push(`<span>Customer: <strong class="text-slate-700">${escapeHtml(customerLabel(_selectedCustomer))}</strong></span>`);
        parts.push('<span class="sep">·</span>');
    }
    const cartItems = [..._cart.values()].reduce((s, l) => s + l.qty, 0);
    const cartLines = _cart.size;
    parts.push(`<span><strong class="text-slate-700">${cartLines}</strong> line${cartLines === 1 ? '' : 's'} (${cartItems} item${cartItems === 1 ? '' : 's'}) in cart</span>`);
    const subtotal = cartSubtotal();
    if (subtotal > 0) {
        parts.push('<span class="sep">·</span>');
        parts.push(`<span><strong class="text-slate-700">${fmtMoney(subtotal)}</strong></span>`);
    }
    if (DEBUG) {
        parts.push('<span class="sep">·</span>');
        parts.push(`<span class="text-slate-400">${_allProducts.length} products · ${_activeRules.length} active rules · ${_customerParts.size} customerparts rows</span>`);
    }
    el.innerHTML = parts.join(' ');
}

function escapeHtml(s) {
    return String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":''' }[c]));
}

// Open the Product module in Fishbowl for a given product num. Wrapped
// so the click handler can no-op gracefully when running outside Fishbowl
// (e.g. opened in a browser tab during development).
//
// Pattern mirrors Part/PartActivity.htm L1081 — straight `openModule(name, num)`.
// CLAUDE.md only documents "Part" but installs that surface Products as
// a separate module accept "Product" too. We try Product first and fall
// back to Part on throw, since in most schemas product.num === part.num.
function openProduct(num) {
    if (DEBUG) qoDebug('openProduct(' + num + ')');
    if (typeof openModule !== 'function') {
        showToast('openModule is unavailable — run inside Fishbowl', 'error', 4000);
        return;
    }
    const s = String(num);
    try {
        openModule('Product', s);
    } catch (e1) {
        if (DEBUG) qoDebug('openModule("Product", "' + s + '") threw — trying Part: ' + e1);
        try { openModule('Part', s); }
        catch (e2) {
            console.warn('openModule failed for both Product and Part:', e2);
            showToast('Failed to open ' + s + ': ' + e2.message, 'error', 5000);
        }
    }
}

// Parse whatever the transport hands back for a datetime column. The shape
// varies: runQueryAsync/REST return ISO or SQL datetime strings, but a
// transport that pre-formats to the install's DateFormatShort would give
// "15/08/2026" — and bare moment()/Date() reads that as MM/DD, so a day
// above 12 is Invalid and a day of 12 or less silently becomes the WRONG
// date (01/08 -> 8 January, not 1 August). Try the unambiguous forms first,
// then the configured short format, and only then fall back to lenient
// parsing.
function parseFbDate(d) {
    if (!d) return null;
    if (d instanceof Date) { const m = moment(d); return m.isValid() ? m : null; }
    const s = String(d).trim();
    if (!s) return null;
    let m = moment(s, [moment.ISO_8601, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.S',
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'], true);
    if (m.isValid()) return m;
    m = moment(s, MOMENT_FMT, true);            // the install's own short format
    if (m.isValid()) return m;
    m = moment(s);                              // last resort
    return m.isValid() ? m : null;
}

function formatDateShort(d) {
    const m = parseFbDate(d);
    return m ? m.format(MOMENT_FMT) : '';
}

// Build the styled-tooltip HTML for a product's open POs. Uses the same
// `.qo-tooltip` palette as the price breakdown so the two read as one
// design system. Shows total remaining at the top, then each PO line
// with vendor + LG + scheduled date + qty.
function poTooltipHtml(pos) {
    if (!pos || !pos.length) return '<div style="color:#94a3b8;font-style:italic;">No open POs</div>';
    const totalRemaining = pos.reduce((s, p) => s + p.qtyRemaining, 0);
    const earliest = pos[0].dateScheduled ? formatDateShort(pos[0].dateScheduled) : '—';

    // Group POs by location group so reps can see at a glance where the
    // incoming stock is landing. Each group sorts its lines by scheduled
    // date (earliest first) so the next-due line for that LG is on top.
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const po of pos) {
        const key = po.lgName || '(No location group)';
        if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
        groups.get(key).push(po);
    }
    const sortedGroups = [...groups.entries()].map(([name, lines]) => {
        lines.sort((a, b) => String(a.dateScheduled || '').localeCompare(String(b.dateScheduled || '')));
        const subtotal = lines.reduce((s, p) => s + p.qtyRemaining, 0);
        return { name, lines, subtotal };
    }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    let html = `<div><span class="lbl">Open POs:</span><span class="val">${pos.length} line${pos.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span></div>`;
    html += `<div><span class="lbl">Total remaining:</span><span class="val">${totalRemaining.toLocaleString()}</span></div>`;
    html += `<div><span class="lbl">Earliest due:</span><span class="val">${earliest}</span></div>`;
    html += `<div style="margin-top:6px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #334155;">`;
    for (const g of sortedGroups) {
        html += `<div class="rule-line" style="margin-top:4px;">▸ ${escapeHtml(g.name)} <span style="color:#94a3b8;font-weight:400;">· ${g.subtotal.toLocaleString()} remaining</span></div>`;
        for (const po of g.lines) {
            const d = po.dateScheduled ? formatDateShort(po.dateScheduled) : 'no date';
            html += `<div style="padding-left:10px;font-size:10px;color:#cbd5e1;">${po.qtyRemaining.toLocaleString()} due ${escapeHtml(d)}</div>`;
        }
    }
    html += `</div>`;
    return html;
}

// Per-LG stock breakdown for the rich tooltip on the stock badge. Lists
// every LG with non-zero qty (plus a "total" header) so a rep can see
// where the stock physically lives without leaving Quick Order.
function stockTooltipHtml(productId) {
    const lgMap = _inventory.get(productId);
    if (!lgMap || lgMap.size === 0) {
        return '<div style="color:#94a3b8;font-style:italic;">No stock on hand</div>';
    }
    const rows = [];
    let total = 0;
    for (const [lgId, qty] of lgMap) {
        const lg = _locationGroups.find(g => g.id === lgId);
        rows.push({ name: lg ? lg.name : `LG #${lgId}`, qty: qty || 0 });
        total += qty || 0;
    }
    // Non-zero LGs first (sorted desc by qty); zero LGs at the bottom for context.
    rows.sort((a, b) => (b.qty || 0) - (a.qty || 0));

    let html = `<div><span class="lbl">Total on hand:</span><span class="val">${total.toLocaleString()}</span></div>`;
    html += `<div style="margin-top:6px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #334155;">`;
    for (const r of rows) {
        if (r.qty === 0) continue;  // skip empty LGs in the main list
        html += `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:10px;padding:1px 0;">`;
        html += `<span style="color:#cbd5e1;">${escapeHtml(r.name)}</span>`;
        html += `<span style="color:#86efac;font-weight:600;">${r.qty.toLocaleString()}</span>`;
        html += `</div>`;
    }
    const empties = rows.filter(r => r.qty === 0);
    if (empties.length) {
        html += `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#64748b;font-style:italic;margin-top:3px;">No stock in: ${empties.map(r => escapeHtml(r.name)).join(', ')}</div>`;
    }
    html += `</div>`;
    return html;
}

// ── Data loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function loadCustomers() {
    // Pull name-joined fields so the ImportSalesOrder CSV (which expects
    // CarrierName / TaxRateName / PaymentTerms as STRINGS, not IDs) can
    // be built without a second lookup pass per submit.
    const rows = await qp(`
        SELECT cu.id, cu.number, cu.name, cu.accountId,
               cu.parentId, par.name AS parentname,
               cu.taxRateId, cu.defaultSalesmanId,
               cu.defaultPaymentTermsId, cu.defaultCarrierId,
               cu.defaultShipTermsId, cu.defaultPriorityId,
               -- Fishbowl's customer.customFields is structured JSON that
               -- CustomFieldByName() unwraps server-side. Trying to
               -- JSON.parse the raw column on the client returned the
               -- wrapping object (not the leaf value).
               -- Favourites are split across up to 5 numbered custom
               -- fields (Favourites_1..Favourites_5) because CFs cap at
               -- 512 chars. The unnumbered field is legacy-read-only
               -- (migrated to the numbered fields on the next write).
               -- Pull both spellings; applyCustomerFavourites picks
               -- whichever is populated.
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favourites') AS favouritescf,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favorites')  AS favoritescf,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favourites_1') AS favcfuk1,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favourites_2') AS favcfuk2,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favourites_3') AS favcfuk3,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favourites_4') AS favcfuk4,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favourites_5') AS favcfuk5,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favorites_1')  AS favcfus1,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favorites_2')  AS favcfus2,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favorites_3')  AS favcfus3,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favorites_4')  AS favcfus4,
               CustomFieldByName(cu.customFields, 'Favorites_5')  AS favcfus5,
               tr.name AS taxratename, tr.code AS taxratecode, tr.rate AS taxraterate,
               car.name AS carriername,
               pt.name AS paymenttermsname,
               sm.userName AS salesmanname,
               st.name AS shiptermsname
        FROM customer cu
        LEFT JOIN customer par ON par.id = cu.parentId
        LEFT JOIN taxrate tr ON tr.id = cu.taxRateId
        LEFT JOIN carrier car ON car.id = cu.defaultCarrierId
        LEFT JOIN paymentterms pt ON pt.id = cu.defaultPaymentTermsId
        LEFT JOIN sysuser sm ON sm.id = cu.defaultSalesmanId
        LEFT JOIN shipterms st ON st.id = cu.defaultShipTermsId
        WHERE cu.activeFlag = 1
        ORDER BY cu.name
        LIMIT 5000
    `);
    // Resolve parent names in JS from the row set itself (id → name)
    // rather than trusting the SQL join alias alone — if a transport
    // ever mis-keys the aliased `par.name` column, children would
    // silently lose their cluster key and fall back to own-name order.
    // The alias stays as fallback for children whose parent is inactive
    // (absent from this activeFlag-filtered list).
    const custNameById = new Map();
    for (const r of rows) {
        const i = intOf(r.id);
        if (i != null && r.name != null) custNameById.set(i, String(r.name));
    }
    _customers = rows.map(r => ({
        id: r.id, num: r.number, name: r.name,
        parentId: r.parentid != null ? intOf(r.parentid) : null,
        parentName: (r.parentid != null ? custNameById.get(intOf(r.parentid)) : null) || r.parentname || '',
        accountId: r.accountid,
        taxRateId: r.taxrateid, taxRateName: r.taxratename || '',
        taxRateCode: r.taxratecode || '',
        taxRateRate: parseFloat(r.taxraterate) || 0,
        salesmanId: r.defaultsalesmanid, salesmanName: r.salesmanname || '',
        paymentTermsId: r.defaultpaymenttermsid, paymentTermsName: r.paymenttermsname || '',
        carrierId: r.defaultcarrierid, carrierName: r.carriername || '',
        shipTermsId: r.defaultshiptermsid, shipTermsName: r.shiptermsname || '',
        priorityId: r.defaultpriorityid || 30,
        // Per-spelling favourite-list values, extracted server-side via
        // CustomFieldByName. Canonical storage is the NUMBERED fields
        // (Favourites_1.._5, each ≤512 chars, each an independently-
        // parseable JSON array — concatenated in order on read). The
        // unnumbered value is legacy single-field data, read-only here;
        // the next write migrates it into the numbered fields.
        favFieldsUK: [r.favcfuk1, r.favcfuk2, r.favcfuk3, r.favcfuk4, r.favcfuk5]
            .map(v => v != null ? String(v) : null),
        favFieldsUS: [r.favcfus1, r.favcfus2, r.favcfus3, r.favcfus4, r.favcfus5]
            .map(v => v != null ? String(v) : null),
        favouritesValueUK: r.favouritescf != null ? String(r.favouritescf) : null,
        favouritesValueUS: r.favoritescf  != null ? String(r.favoritescf)  : null,
    }));
    // Order the picker so each parent's sub-customers cluster directly
    // under it. Everyone sorts by their CLUSTER key — the parent's name
    // for children, own name otherwise — so parents keep their normal
    // alphabetical position; within a cluster the parent row comes
    // first, then its children alphabetically.
    _customers.sort((a, b) => {
        const ka = a.parentName || a.name;
        const kb = b.parentName || b.name;
        const r = ka.localeCompare(kb, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true });
        if (r !== 0) return r;
        const ac = a.parentName ? 1 : 0;
        const bc = b.parentName ? 1 : 0;
        if (ac !== bc) return ac - bc;   // parent before its children
        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true });
    });
    // Detect ambiguous customer labels. Sub-customers already render as
    // "Parent > Name", so a same-named sub-customer and top-level
    // customer are distinguishable by the path alone. Only when two
    // records produce the SAME full label (true duplicates) does
    // customerLabel() append the customer number.
    const labelCounts = new Map();
    for (const c of _customers) {
        const lbl = customerBaseLabel(c);
        labelCounts.set(lbl, (labelCounts.get(lbl) || 0) + 1);
    }
    _duplicateCustomerNames = new Set([...labelCounts.entries()].filter(([, n]) => n > 1).map(([lbl]) => lbl));
    updateMSTrigger('cust');
    updateMobileCustomerLabel();
    if (_pendingSelectedCustomerId) {
        const c = _customers.find(x => x.id === _pendingSelectedCustomerId);
        if (c) await selectCustomer(c, /*skipSave*/true);
        _pendingSelectedCustomerId = null;
    }
}

// Customer addresses — required for the ImportSalesOrder CSV (BillTo /
// ShipTo are mandatory columns). Linked via address.accountId, NOT
// customer.id — see schema-customers-vendors.sql L8.
async function loadCustomerAddresses(customer) {
    _customerAddresses = [];
    _selectedBillToId = null;
    _selectedShipToId = null;
    if (!customer || !customer.accountId) return;
    const rows = await qp(`
        SELECT a.id, a.name AS label, a.addressName AS recipient,
               a.address AS street, a.city, a.zip,
               s.code AS statecode, s.name AS statename,
               co.name AS country, co.abbreviation AS countryabbrev,
               a.defaultFlag, a.typeID, t.name AS typename,
               a.residentialFlag
        FROM address a
        LEFT JOIN stateconst s ON s.id = a.stateId
        LEFT JOIN countryconst co ON co.id = a.countryId
        LEFT JOIN addresstype t ON t.id = a.typeID
        WHERE a.accountId = ${customer.accountId}
        ORDER BY a.defaultFlag DESC, a.typeID, a.name
    `);
    _customerAddresses = rows.map(r => ({
        id: r.id,
        label: r.label || r.recipient || `Address ${r.id}`,
        recipient: r.recipient || r.label || customer.name,
        street: r.street || '',
        city: r.city || '',
        state: r.statecode || r.statename || '',
        zip: r.zip || '',
        country: r.country || '',
        // The CSV importer resolves the country by NAME; the REST create
        // documents shipToAddress.country as the abbreviation. Carry both so
        // neither route has to guess — see addrForRest() / buildImportPayload().
        countryAbbrev: r.countryabbrev || '',
        defaultFlag: bitTrue(r.defaultflag),
        typeId: intOf(r.typeid),
        typeName: r.typename || '',
        residential: bitTrue(r.residentialflag),
    }));
    // Default ship-to: prefer Ship-type (40), then default-flagged, then first.
    // Default bill-to: prefer Bill-type (20), then Main (10), then default-flagged.
    const find = pred => (_customerAddresses.find(pred) || _customerAddresses[0]);
    if (_customerAddresses.length) {
        _selectedShipToId = find(a => a.typeName.toLowerCase().includes('ship'))?.id
                         ?? find(a => a.defaultFlag)?.id
                         ?? _customerAddresses[0].id;
        _selectedBillToId = find(a => a.typeName.toLowerCase().includes('bill'))?.id
                         ?? find(a => a.typeName.toLowerCase().includes('main'))?.id
                         ?? find(a => a.defaultFlag)?.id
                         ?? _customerAddresses[0].id;
    }
}

async function loadProductTrees() {
    const rows = await qp(`SELECT id, name, parentId FROM producttree ORDER BY name`);
    _productTrees = rows.map(r => ({
        id: intOf(r.id), name: r.name || '',
        parentId: r.parentid != null ? intOf(r.parentid) : null,
    })).filter(t => t.id != null);
    buildTreeIndex();
    updateMSTrigger('tree');
}

// Build the client-side hierarchy index from _productTrees (adjacency
// list). Populates _treeById (with children arrays) + _treeRoots.
function buildTreeIndex() {
    _treeById = new Map();
    _treeRoots = [];
    for (const t of _productTrees) {
        _treeById.set(t.id, { id: t.id, name: t.name, parentId: t.parentId, children: [] });
    }
    for (const node of _treeById.values()) {
        const pid = node.parentId;
        const parent = (pid != null && pid > 0) ? _treeById.get(pid) : null;
        if (parent) parent.children.push(node);
        else _treeRoots.push(node);
    }
    const byName = (a, b) => String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true });
    _treeRoots.sort(byName);
    for (const node of _treeById.values()) node.children.sort(byName);
}

// Top level shown in the Category filter. Fishbowl ships a single
// synthetic root "Product" (id 1) that contains every real category, so
// when there's exactly one root with children we render ITS CHILDREN as
// the top level (the real "main" categories) and hide the redundant
// root. Otherwise render the roots directly.
function treeTopLevel() {
    if (_treeRoots.length === 1 && _treeRoots[0].children.length) return _treeRoots[0].children;
    return _treeRoots;
}

// Ancestor chain [root … node] of node objects for a tree id.
function treeAncestryChain(id) {
    const chain = [];
    let cur = _treeById.get(intOf(id));
    let guard = 0;
    while (cur && guard++ < 64) {
        chain.unshift(cur);
        cur = (cur.parentId != null && cur.parentId > 0) ? _treeById.get(cur.parentId) : null;
    }
    return chain;
}

// MAIN (top-level) category for a tag id — the child-of-root ancestor
// (i.e. skip the synthetic "Product" root). Returns {id,name} or null.
function treeMainOf(id) {
    const chain = treeAncestryChain(id);
    if (!chain.length) return null;
    const main = chain.length > 1 ? chain[1] : chain[0];
    return { id: main.id, name: main.name };
}

// Full display path "Main › Sub › Leaf" for a tag id (excludes the
// synthetic root).
function treePathStr(id) {
    const chain = treeAncestryChain(id);
    if (!chain.length) return '';
    const nodes = chain.length > 1 ? chain.slice(1) : chain;
    return nodes.map(n => n.name).join(' › ');
}

// Set of {node id + all descendant ids} as STRINGS — used for cascade
// selection and for expanding a selected branch into a filter id set.
function treeDescendants(id) {
    const out = new Set();
    const node = _treeById.get(intOf(id));
    if (!node) { out.add(String(id)); return out; }
    (function walk(n) { out.add(String(n.id)); n.children.forEach(walk); })(node);
    return out;
}

// Selection state of a node for the tri-state checkbox: checked when the
// whole subtree is selected, indeterminate when only part of it is.
function treeNodeSelState(node) {
    const desc = treeDescendants(node.id);
    let sel = 0, tot = 0;
    for (const idStr of desc) { tot++; if (_filters.productTreeIds.has(idStr)) sel++; }
    if (sel === 0) return { checked: false, indeterminate: false };
    if (sel === tot) return { checked: true, indeterminate: false };
    return { checked: false, indeterminate: true };
}

// Cascade a node on/off: add or remove the node + every descendant id.
function treeToggleNode(node, on) {
    const desc = treeDescendants(node.id);
    if (on) desc.forEach(id => _filters.productTreeIds.add(id));
    else    desc.forEach(id => _filters.productTreeIds.delete(id));
}

// The "top" selected nodes — a selected node whose parent isn't selected.
// Used for the concise trigger summary (one tag per chosen branch).
function selectedTreeTops() {
    const res = [];
    for (const idStr of _filters.productTreeIds) {
        const node = _treeById.get(parseInt(idStr, 10));
        if (!node) continue;
        const pid = node.parentId;
        const parentSelected = pid != null && pid > 0 && _filters.productTreeIds.has(String(pid));
        if (!parentSelected) res.push(node);
    }
    res.sort((a, b) => String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true }));
    return res;
}

// Render the nested Category filter into #treeList. Collapsed by default
// (only the main categories show); carets expand branches; checking a
// node cascades to its whole subtree. A search term flattens to matching
// nodes (with their path) — checkboxes still cascade.
function renderTreeFilterList(listEl, search) {
    listEl.innerHTML = '';
    if (!_treeById.size) { listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ms-empty">No categories</div>'; return; }
    const term = (search || '').trim().toLowerCase();

    const makeRow = (node, depth, showPath) => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'ms-tree-row';
        row.style.paddingLeft = (6 + depth * 16) + 'px';

        const hasKids = node.children && node.children.length;
        const caret = document.createElement('span');
        caret.className = 'ms-tree-caret';
        if (hasKids && !term) {
            const open = _treeExpanded.has(node.id);
            caret.textContent = open ? '▾' : '▸';
            caret.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (_treeExpanded.has(node.id)) _treeExpanded.delete(node.id);
                else _treeExpanded.add(node.id);
                renderTreeFilterList(listEl, search);
            };
        } else {
            caret.innerHTML = ' ';
        }
        row.appendChild(caret);

        const cb = document.createElement('input');
        cb.type = 'checkbox';
        const st = treeNodeSelState(node);
        cb.checked = st.checked;
        cb.indeterminate = st.indeterminate;
        cb.onchange = () => {
            treeToggleNode(node, cb.checked);
            updateMSTrigger('tree');
            renderTreeFilterList(listEl, search);   // refresh parent/child states
            applyAllFilters();
        };
        row.appendChild(cb);

        const lbl = document.createElement('span');
        lbl.className = 'ms-tree-label';
        lbl.textContent = node.name;
        if (showPath) {
            const s = document.createElement('span');
            s.className = 'sub';
            s.textContent = ' · ' + treePathStr(node.id);
            lbl.appendChild(s);
        }
        lbl.onclick = () => { cb.checked = !cb.checked; cb.onchange(); };
        row.appendChild(lbl);

        listEl.appendChild(row);

        if (hasKids && !term && _treeExpanded.has(node.id)) {
            node.children.forEach(ch => makeRow(ch, depth + 1, false));
        }
    };

    if (term) {
        const matches = [..._treeById.values()]
            .filter(n => n.name.toLowerCase().includes(term))
            .sort((a, b) => String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true }));
        if (!matches.length) { listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ms-empty">No matches</div>'; return; }
        matches.forEach(n => makeRow(n, 0, true));
    } else {
        treeTopLevel().forEach(n => makeRow(n, 0, false));
    }
}

// ── Category paths for a product (list grouping + Category column) ────
// A product (producttotree) can carry several tags. productCatPaths
// returns one {mainId, mainName, pathStr} per distinct tagged path;
// productMainCats collapses those to distinct MAIN categories (the level
// list/print grouping uses). Untagged products fall under "Uncategorised".
function productCatPaths(product) {
    const ids = (product && product.treeIds) || [];
    const out = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const id of ids) {
        const main = treeMainOf(id);
        const pathStr = treePathStr(id) || (main ? main.name : '');
        if (!pathStr || seen.has(pathStr)) continue;
        seen.add(pathStr);
        out.push({ mainId: main ? main.id : null, mainName: main ? main.name : 'Uncategorised', pathStr });
    }
    if (!out.length) out.push({ mainId: null, mainName: 'Uncategorised', pathStr: 'Uncategorised' });
    return out;
}
function productMainCats(product) {
    const seen = new Map();
    for (const p of productCatPaths(product)) {
        const k = p.mainId == null ? '~' : String(p.mainId);
        if (!seen.has(k)) seen.set(k, { id: p.mainId, name: p.mainName });
    }
    return [...seen.values()];
}
// Product-level sort key for the Category column — its alphabetically
// first path so ungrouped sort-by-category is stable.
function productCatSortKey(product) {
    let k = null;
    for (const p of productCatPaths(product)) {
        if (k === null || p.pathStr.localeCompare(k, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true }) < 0) k = p.pathStr;
    }
    return k || '';
}

// Company-level defaults — used as a fallback when a customer record has
// no defaultCarrierId. Sending an empty CarrierName in the ImportSalesOrder
// CSV produces "Unknown Carrier on line number 3" on installs where
// Fishbowl doesn't auto-substitute a default; sending the company's own
// default carrier matches what the desktop SO module would have used.
// Single-row table (typically) — defaultFlag=1 is the active company.
async function loadCompanyDefaults() {
    try {
        const rows = await qp(`
            SELECT co.defaultCarrierId, car.name AS carriername
            FROM company co
            LEFT JOIN carrier car ON car.id = co.defaultCarrierId
            WHERE co.defaultFlag = 1
            ORDER BY co.id
            LIMIT 1
        `);
        if (rows && rows.length) {
            _companyDefaults.carrierId   = rows[0].defaultcarrierid || null;
            _companyDefaults.carrierName = rows[0].carriername || '';
        }
    } catch (e) {
        // Non-fatal: orders will still submit, just without the fallback.
        if (typeof qoDebug === 'function') qoDebug('loadCompanyDefaults failed: ' + e.message, 'warn');
    }
}

// Active carrier list for the cart drawer dropdown.
async function loadCarriers() {

        _carriers = rows.map(r => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name || '' }));
