    const num = so.number != null ? so.number
              : so.num    != null ? so.num
              : so.soNumber != null ? so.soNumber : null;
    return {
        id:  so.id != null ? intOf(so.id) : null,
        num: num != null ? String(num) : null,
    };
}

// Which create route this session uses. Session-scoped and deliberately NOT
// persisted through saveState(): that blob follows the user between servers,
// so a cached 'csv' would outlive a server upgrade and pin them to the legacy
// route forever. One wasted round trip per session is the cheaper mistake.
let _soCreateRoute = 'unknown';   // 'unknown' | 'rest' | 'csv'

// Create the order, preferring REST and falling back to the CSV importer.
// Returns { route, created } where created is {id, num} or null.
async function submitSoCreate(statusOverride) {
    // Kits / drop-ship lines are 422 on the REST route but fine through the
    // importer, so divert the whole order rather than fail it.
    if (_soCreateRoute !== 'csv') {
        const blocked = unsupportedRestLines();
        if (blocked.length) {
            const names = blocked.map(l => l.product && l.product.num).filter(Boolean).join(', ');
            qoDebug('Kit/drop-ship line(s) present (' + names + ') — using the CSV import route '
                  + 'for this order; the REST create rejects them with 422.', 'warn');
            const payload = buildImportPayload(statusOverride);
            if (!payload) throw new Error('Could not build the order payload.');
            await submitSoImport(payload.ImportRq.Rows.Row.join('\n'), payload);
            return { route: 'csv', created: null };
        }
    }

    if (_soCreateRoute !== 'csv') {
        for (const omitSalesperson of [false, true]) {
            const body = buildSoRestPayload(statusOverride, { omitSalesperson });
            if (!body) throw new Error('Could not build the order payload.');
            try {
                const resp = await submitSoRest(body);
                _soCreateRoute = 'rest';
                return { route: 'rest', created: extractCreatedSo(resp) };
            } catch (err) {
                const st = restErrStatus(err);
                // Route absent on this server build — this is the only case
                // that may silently fall through to CSV. A 400/403/422 is a
                // real rejection and must reach the user: falling back there
                // would create, via a different code path, an order they were
                // never given the chance to validate.
                if (st === 405 || st === 404) {
                    _soCreateRoute = 'csv';
                    qoDebug('POST /api/sales-orders returned ' + st + ' — this server does not '
                          + 'support the native create; using the CSV import route.', 'warn');
                    break;
                }
                // Salesperson override refused: retry once without it, which
                // credits the order to the signed-in user instead.
                if (st === 403 && !omitSalesperson && /salesperson/i.test(String(err.message || ''))) {
                    qoDebug('Salesperson override rejected (needs SO_EDIT_SALESPERSON) — retrying '
                          + 'with the order credited to the signed-in user.', 'warn');
                    continue;
                }
                throw err;
            }
        }
    }

    const payload = buildImportPayload(statusOverride);
    if (!payload) throw new Error('Could not build the order payload.');
    await submitSoImport(payload.ImportRq.Rows.Row.join('\n'), payload);
    return { route: 'csv', created: null };
}

async function createSalesOrder() {
    if (!_selectedCustomer) { showToast('Select a customer first', 'error', 4000); return; }
    if (_cart.size === 0)   { showToast('Cart is empty', 'error', 4000); return; }
    // The legacy ImportRq bridge is fishbowl-only, but the REST import
    // endpoint works in every MODE — no early-bail check needed any more.
    if (!_customerAddresses.length) {
        showToast('This customer has no addresses on file — add one in the Customer module first.', 'error', 8000);
        return;
    }
    if (!_selectedShipToId || !_selectedBillToId) {
        showToast('Select both ship-to and bill-to addresses first', 'error', 5000);
        return;
    }

    const lineCount = _cart.size;
    const total = cartSubtotal();
    const tax = cartTax();
    // Per-order status override. Default-selects whatever's in Settings,
    // but the rep can switch Estimate ↔ Issued for this one order without
    // touching the saved default. Styled to match .hdr-btn so it sits in
    // the modal naturally; tabular-nums kept off (alpha labels).
    const statusSelect =
        `<select id="qoStatusSelect" class="hdr-btn" style="padding:3px 8px; font-size:12px;">` +
            `<option value="10"${_defaultStatusId === 10 ? ' selected' : ''}>Estimate</option>` +
            `<option value="20"${_defaultStatusId === 20 ? ' selected' : ''}>Issued</option>` +
        `</select>`;
    // SO-details for the modal — same values that go into the CSV. The
    // carrier line shows the effective name (override/customer/company)
    // so the rep can spot a missing carrier before submitting.
    const modalCarrier = effectiveCarrierName() || '—';
    // Ship-to / bill-to / date-scheduled are EDITABLE here, not just
    // echoed. Both addresses are auto-picked when the customer loads
    // (first Ship-type / Bill-type, else the default-flagged one), so a
    // customer with several addresses gets a silent choice — this is
    // the last point at which the rep can correct it without cancelling
    // out to the cart drawer. Values are read back in
    // applyModalOrderEdits() after the dialog resolves.
    const modalAddrBlock =
        `<div style="margin-top:8px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;">` +
            `<label style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0;">` +
                `<span style="font-size:10px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:var(--muted-2);">Ship To</span>` +
                `<select id="qoModalShipTo" class="hdr-btn" style="width:100%; min-width:0; padding:4px 6px; font-size:12px; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${addressOptionsHtml(_selectedShipToId)}</select>` +
            `</label>` +
            `<label style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0;">` +
                `<span style="font-size:10px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:var(--muted-2);">Bill To</span>` +
                `<select id="qoModalBillTo" class="hdr-btn" style="width:100%; min-width:0; padding:4px 6px; font-size:12px; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${addressOptionsHtml(_selectedBillToId)}</select>` +
            `</label>` +
        `</div>`;
    // Blank date = "use today", matching the CSV fallback in
    // buildImportPayload — the hint says so rather than pre-filling the
    // input, which would turn an implicit default into an explicit date.
    const modalDateRow =
        `<div class="kv" style="align-items:center; margin-top:6px;">` +
            `<span class="k">Date Scheduled</span>` +
            `<span class="v"><input type="date" id="qoModalDateScheduled" value="${escapeHtml(_orderDateScheduled || '')}" ` +
                `style="padding:3px 6px; font-size:12px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:6px; background:#fff; font-family:inherit; color:#0f172a;"></span>` +
        `</div>` +
        (_orderDateScheduled ? '' :
            `<div style="font-size:10px; color:var(--muted-2); text-align:right; margin-top:-2px;">Blank = today (${escapeHtml(todayShort())})</div>`);

    const ok = await showConfirm({
        title: 'Create sales order?',
        body:
            `<p>For <strong>${escapeHtml(_selectedCustomer.name)}</strong></p>` +
            `<div class="kv"><span class="k">Lines</span><span class="v">${lineCount}</span></div>` +
            `<div class="kv"><span class="k">Subtotal</span><span class="v">${fmtMoney(total)}</span></div>` +
            (tax > 0 ? `<div class="kv"><span class="k">Tax</span><span class="v">${fmtMoney(tax)}</span></div>` : '') +
            `<div class="kv"><span class="k">Total</span><span class="v">${fmtMoney(total + tax)}</span></div>` +
            `<div class="kv" style="align-items:center;"><span class="k">Status</span><span class="v">${statusSelect}</span></div>` +
            (_despatchLg ? `<div class="kv"><span class="k">Despatch LG</span><span class="v">${escapeHtml(_despatchLg.name)}</span></div>` : '') +
            `<div class="kv"><span class="k">Carrier</span><span class="v">${escapeHtml(modalCarrier)}</span></div>` +
            (_orderCustomerPO ? `<div class="kv"><span class="k">Customer PO</span><span class="v">${escapeHtml(_orderCustomerPO)}</span></div>` : '') +
            modalDateRow +
            modalAddrBlock +
            (_orderNote
                ? `<div style="margin-top:6px;padding:6px 8px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;color:#0f172a;line-height:1.45;white-space:pre-wrap;">${escapeHtml(_orderNote)}</div>`
                : '') +
            `<p style="margin-top:8px;color:var(--muted-2);font-size:11px;">SO number will be auto-assigned by Fishbowl.</p>`,
        okLabel: 'Create order',
    });
    if (!ok) return;
    // Read the per-order status pick BEFORE building the payload. The
    // modal is hidden (display:none) after showConfirm resolves, but its
    // content stays in the DOM so the select is still queryable.
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('qoStatusSelect');
    const chosenStatus = statusEl ? statusEl.value : _defaultStatusId;
    // Same deal for the ship-to / bill-to / date-scheduled controls —
    // commit them to the live order state so buildImportPayload (which
    // reads the globals) picks up any last-second change.
    applyModalOrderEdits();
    // Validate up front that a payload can be built at all — submitSoCreate()
    // decides which of the two it actually sends.
    if (!buildImportPayload(chosenStatus)) {
        showToast('Could not build the order payload', 'error', 5000);
        return;
    }

    const btn = document.getElementById('createSoBtn');
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.style.opacity = '0.5'; }

    try {
        // Prefers POST /api/sales-orders, falling back to the CSV importer on
        // servers that don't register it. Both routes work in every MODE.
        const { route, created } = await submitSoCreate(chosenStatus);

        // The REST route returns the created order, so the number is
        // authoritative. The CSV route echoes nothing, so fall back to the
        // old guess — the latest row for this customer is ours. Small window
        // for a concurrent SO from another user to sneak in, but negligible,
        // and it no longer applies at all once REST is available.
        let newSoNum = created && created.num ? created.num : null;
        if (!newSoNum) {
            try {
                const found = await qp(`
                    SELECT num FROM so
                    WHERE customerId = ${_selectedCustomer.id}
                    ORDER BY id DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                `);
                if (found && found.length) newSoNum = String(found[0].num);
            } catch (lookupErr) {
                if (DEBUG) qoDebug('Post-create SO lookup failed: ' + lookupErr, 'warn');
            }
        }
        if (DEBUG) qoDebug('SO created via ' + route + ' route: ' + (newSoNum || '(number unknown)'));
        // Invalidate the Orders view cache so a freshly created order shows
        // up the next time that view is opened.
        _orders = [];

        showToast(newSoNum ? `✓ Sales order ${newSoNum} created` : `✓ Sales order created`, 'success', 6000);
        _cart.clear();
        // Per-order SO-detail fields reset for the next quote.
        _orderCustomerPO    = '';
        _orderDateScheduled = '';
        _orderNote          = '';
        // Deselect the customer so the next order starts from a clean
        // slate — selectCustomer(null) drops the pricing rules, purchase
        // history, addresses and customer favourites, resets the carrier
        // to the company default, and re-renders the catalogue, cart,
        // status line and both customer triggers.
        //
        // Guarded: the SO is already created at this point, so a throw in
        // the reset path must not fall through to the catch below and
        // report a failure that didn't happen.
        try { await selectCustomer(null); }
        catch (resetErr) {
            if (DEBUG) qoDebug('Post-submit customer reset failed: ' + resetErr, 'warn');
        }
        // On mobile, close the cart drawer so the success toast is
        // visible above the catalogue. No-op on desktop where the
        // cart is always visible.
        closeCartDrawer();

        // openModule is fishbowl-only — silently skip in portal/standalone.
        // Gated by the Settings → "Jump to SO module after create" toggle
        // so reps batch-creating quotes can stay in Quick Order. Delay
        // ~1.5s when we do navigate, so the success toast gets a chance
        // to be seen + the post-import race window has time to settle.
        if (_autoOpenSo && newSoNum && typeof openModule === 'function') {
            setTimeout(() => {
                try { openModule('Sales Order', newSoNum); }
                catch (e) { if (DEBUG) qoDebug('openModule failed: ' + e, 'warn'); }
            }, 1500);
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('createSalesOrder failed:', err);
        const detail = errText(err);
        // When the failure is a server-unreachable signal (502/503/504
        // or network error), the dedicated server-status pill is now
        // visible; the toast can be shorter + friendlier. Cart is
        // preserved either way — user can retry once the pill clears.
        const isUnreachable = MODE === 'portal' && _serverStatus !== 'ok';
        // Translate the two REST rejections a rep can actually act on. Without
        // this they surface as a raw server string that reads like a bug.
        const st = restErrStatus(err);
        let msg;
        if (isUnreachable) {
            msg = 'Fishbowl is unreachable — your cart is preserved. Wait for the reconnect indicator to clear, then retry.';
        } else if (st === 403 && /price/i.test(detail)) {
            msg = 'Your Fishbowl account can\'t override sales-order prices, which Quick Order '
                + 'needs in order to send its calculated prices. Ask an admin for the '
                + 'SO Price Override right. Your cart is preserved.';
        } else if (st === 422) {
            msg = 'Fishbowl rejected a line on this order: ' + detail
                + ' — your cart is preserved.';
        } else {
            msg = 'Failed to create SO: ' + detail;
        }
        showToast(msg, 'error', isUnreachable ? 8000 : 12000);
        if (DEBUG) qoDebug('Create error: ' + detail, 'error');
    } finally {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.style.opacity = '1'; }
        renderCart();
    }
}

// Commit the create-SO modal's ship-to / bill-to / date-scheduled
// controls back into the live order state. Called only after the dialog
// is CONFIRMED — cancelling discards the edits, so a rep who changes an
// address then backs out doesn't silently mutate the cart drawer.
//
// showConfirm hides the modal but leaves its content in the DOM, so the
// controls are still queryable at this point (same trick the status
// select uses). Returns true if anything actually changed.
function applyModalOrderEdits() {
    let changed = false;
    const shipEl = document.getElementById('qoModalShipTo');
    const billEl = document.getElementById('qoModalBillTo');
    const dateEl = document.getElementById('qoModalDateScheduled');
    if (shipEl) {
        const id = intOf(shipEl.value);
        if (id != null && id !== _selectedShipToId) { _selectedShipToId = id; changed = true; }
    }
    if (billEl) {
        const id = intOf(billEl.value);
        if (id != null && id !== _selectedBillToId) { _selectedBillToId = id; changed = true; }
    }
    if (dateEl) {
        const v = (dateEl.value || '').trim();
        if (v !== _orderDateScheduled) { _orderDateScheduled = v; changed = true; }
    }
    // Re-sync the cart drawer so its selectors + collapsed summary match
    // what's about to be submitted.
    if (changed) renderAddressPickers();
    return changed;
}

function safeParse(s) { try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (e) { return s; } }

// Pull a useful error message out of an Import response — Fishbowl's
// XML→JSON conversion buries `statusMessage` at varying depths.
function extractImportError(obj) {
    if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return null;
    for (const k of Object.keys(obj)) {
        if (/statusmessage/i.test(k) && obj[k]) return String(obj[k]);
        if (typeof obj[k] === 'object') {
            const nested = extractImportError(obj[k]);
            if (nested) return nested;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

// <option> list for a ship-to / bill-to selector, with `selectedId`
// pre-selected. Shared by the cart drawer and the create-SO
// confirmation modal so both always show identical labels.
// Per-option glyph keyed off addresstype.name — <option> can't render
// SVG, so Unicode: 🚚 ship · 💲 bill · 🏢 main/office · 📍 other.
function addressOptionsHtml(selectedId) {
    const glyphFor = a => {
        const t = (a.typeName || '').toLowerCase();
        if (t.includes('ship'))   return '🚚';
        if (t.includes('bill'))   return '💲';
        if (t.includes('remit'))  return '💲';
        if (t.includes('main') || t.includes('office')) return '🏢';
        return '📍';
    };
    return _customerAddresses.map(a => {
        // Show address.addressName (the formal recipient line) as the
        // primary label — this is what reps recognise. Fall back to the
        // address.name nickname if addressName isn't set.
        const primary = a.recipient || a.label;
        const loc = [a.city, a.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
        const lbl = `${glyphFor(a)}  ${primary}${loc ? ' — ' + loc : ''}`;
        return `<option value="${a.id}"${a.id === selectedId ? ' selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(lbl)}</option>`;
    }).join('');
}

function renderAddressPickers() {
    const wrap = document.getElementById('soDetails');
    const shipSel = document.getElementById('shipToSelect');
    const billSel = document.getElementById('billToSelect');
    const carSel = document.getElementById('carrierSelect');
    const poInp  = document.getElementById('customerPoInput');
    const dsInp  = document.getElementById('dateScheduledInput');
    const warn = document.getElementById('addressWarning');
    if (!wrap || !shipSel || !billSel) return;

    if (!_selectedCustomer) {
        wrap.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    wrap.style.display = 'block';

    // ── Carrier dropdown — list of all active carriers; defaults to the
    //    one already chosen (_orderCarrierId, set by initOrderDetailsForCustomer).
    if (carSel) {
        const opts = ['<option value="">(use company default)</option>']
            .concat(_carriers.map(c => `<option value="${c.id}">${escapeHtml(c.name)}</option>`))
            .join('');
        carSel.innerHTML = opts;
        carSel.value = _orderCarrierId ? String(_orderCarrierId) : '';
    }
    if (poInp) poInp.value = _orderCustomerPO || '';
    if (dsInp) dsInp.value = _orderDateScheduled || '';
    renderOrderNoteButton();

    if (_customerAddresses.length === 0) {
        shipSel.innerHTML = '<option>—</option>';
        billSel.innerHTML = '<option>—</option>';
        shipSel.disabled = true; billSel.disabled = true;
        if (warn) warn.style.display = 'block';
        renderSoDetailsSummary();
        applySoDetailsExpandedState();
        return;
    }
    if (warn) warn.style.display = 'none';
    shipSel.disabled = false; billSel.disabled = false;

    shipSel.innerHTML = addressOptionsHtml(_selectedShipToId);
    billSel.innerHTML = addressOptionsHtml(_selectedBillToId);
    if (_selectedShipToId) shipSel.value = String(_selectedShipToId);
    if (_selectedBillToId) billSel.value = String(_selectedBillToId);

    renderSoDetailsSummary();
    applySoDetailsExpandedState();
}

function onAddressChange(which, val) {
    const id = parseInt(val, 10);
    if (isNaN(id)) return;
    if (which === 'ship') _selectedShipToId = id;
    else                  _selectedBillToId = id;
    renderSoDetailsSummary();
}

// ── SO-details drawer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Reset/auto-populate the order-level fields whenever a customer is picked.
// Carrier resolves to: customer.defaultCarrierId  →  company.defaultCarrierId  →  '' (none).
// Customer PO + date scheduled are per-order, so reset to defaults.
function initOrderDetailsForCustomer(cust) {
    if (cust && cust.carrierId) {
        _orderCarrierId   = cust.carrierId;
        _orderCarrierName = cust.carrierName || '';
    } else if (_companyDefaults.carrierId) {
        _orderCarrierId   = _companyDefaults.carrierId;
        _orderCarrierName = _companyDefaults.carrierName || '';
    } else {
        _orderCarrierId   = null;
        _orderCarrierName = '';
    }
    _orderCustomerPO    = '';
    _orderDateScheduled = '';  // Empty = use today at submit time (matches prior behaviour)
    _orderNote          = '';
    renderOrderNoteButton();
}

function onCarrierChange(val) {
    const id = parseInt(val, 10);
    if (isNaN(id)) {
        // "(use company default)" — fall through to the company fallback
        // at submit time; clearing both lets effectiveCarrierName() pick
        // the right thing on demand.
        _orderCarrierId = null;
        _orderCarrierName = '';
    } else {
        const c = _carriers.find(x => x.id === id);
        _orderCarrierId = id;
        _orderCarrierName = c ? c.name : '';
    }
    renderSoDetailsSummary();
}

function onCustomerPoChange(v) {
    _orderCustomerPO = (v || '').trim().slice(0, 80);
    renderSoDetailsSummary();
}

function onDateScheduledChange(v) {
    // <input type="date"> hands back YYYY-MM-DD; store as-is, convert
    // to MOMENT_FMT only when emitting the CSV row.
    _orderDateScheduled = (v || '').trim();
    renderSoDetailsSummary();
}

// ── Order-note modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Notes can be long (delivery instructions, picking instructions); a
// modal with a sized textarea is friendlier than an inline input.
function openOrderNoteModal() {
    const m = document.getElementById('qoOrderNoteModal');
    const ta = document.getElementById('qoOrderNoteTextarea');

    ta.value = _orderNote || '';

    m.classList.add('open');

}
function closeOrderNoteModal() {
    const m = document.getElementById('qoOrderNoteModal');

    m.classList.remove('open');
    m.style.display = 'none';
}
function saveOrderNote() {
    const ta = document.getElementById('qoOrderNoteTextarea');
    _orderNote = ta ? (ta.value || '').trim() : '';
    renderOrderNoteButton();
    closeOrderNoteModal();
}
function clearOrderNote() {

    if (ta) ta.value = '';

}
function updateOrderNoteCount() {
    const ta = document.getElementById('qoOrderNoteTextarea');
    const cnt = document.getElementById('qoOrderNoteCount');
    if (ta && cnt) cnt.textContent = `${(ta.value || '').length} character${ta.value.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
}
function renderOrderNoteButton() {
    const lbl = document.getElementById('orderNoteBtnLabel');
    if (!lbl) return;
    if (_orderNote && _orderNote.trim()) {
        lbl.textContent = _orderNote.length > 60 ? _orderNote.slice(0, 57) + '…' : _orderNote;
        lbl.style.color = '#0f172a';
        lbl.style.fontWeight = '500';
    } else {
        lbl.textContent = '(click to add note)';
        lbl.style.color = '#64748b';
        lbl.style.fontWeight = '400';
    }
}

// ── Print favourites order sheet ────────────────────────────────────
// Builds a printable order sheet for the selected customer's favourite
// products. Layout matches the customer-provided sample:
//   - ORDER SHEET title
//   - Customer name + (company) phone
//   - Table grouped by product tree (rowspan on the category cell),
//     with product num, description, UOM, then 4 empty columns
//     under a "Dates / Quantities" header for the rep / customer to
//     hand-write upcoming order dates + qty.
// Opens in a fresh window and calls print on THAT window — per the
// reference_jxbrowser_print_workaround note, window.print() against
// the host JxBrowser page is unreliable; printing a fresh popup is.
async function printCustomerFavourites() {
    if (!_selectedCustomer) {
        showToast('Select a customer first to print their order sheet', 'info', 4000);
        return;
    }
    if (_customerFavourites.size === 0) {
        showToast('No customer favourites set — click the green star on products first', 'info', 5000);
        return;
    }

    // Resolve favourite product IDs against fresh DB data, joined ONLY
    // to the `uom` table (never to `part`). Each variant therefore
    // gets its OWN product.description and its OWN product.uomid → uom
    // record, with no chance of substituting the part's description or
    // primary-UOM. This also picks up INACTIVE variant products which
    // _allProducts has filtered out via `activeflag = 1` — the rep still
    // wants those on the printed sheet.
    const favIds = [..._customerFavourites].map(x => intOf(x)).filter(x => x != null);
    const byId = new Map();
    for (const p of _allProducts) byId.set(p.id, p);

    let dbById = new Map();
    if (favIds.length) {
        try {
            const rows = await qp(`
                SELECT product.id AS id,
                       product.num AS num,
                       product.description AS description,
                       product.partid AS partid,
                       uom.code AS uomcode,
                       uom.name AS uomname
                FROM product
                LEFT JOIN uom ON product.uomid = uom.id
                WHERE product.id IN (${favIds.join(',')})
            `);
            for (const r of rows) dbById.set(intOf(r.id), r);
        } catch (e) {
            if (DEBUG) qoDebug('printCustomerFavourites: fav product lookup failed: ' + e.message, 'warn');
        }
    }

    // Merge: prefer fresh DB row (authoritative product-level data) ▸
    // in-memory cache (only used to back-fill treeIds, since the DB
    // lookup deliberately doesn't join producttree). When a favourite
    // id matches NEITHER, render a stub so the row still appears.
    const favProducts = favIds.map(id => {
        const fresh = dbById.get(id);
        const mem   = byId.get(id);
        return {
            id:          id,
            num:         (fresh && fresh.num) || (mem && mem.num) || String(id),
            description: (fresh && fresh.description) || (mem && mem.description) || '',
            uomCode:     (fresh && fresh.uomcode)     || (mem && mem.uomCode)     || '',
            uomName:     (fresh && fresh.uomname)     || (mem && mem.uomName)     || '',
            treeIds:     (mem && mem.treeIds) || [],
        };
    });

    // Group by MAIN (top-level) product category. Per the customer's
    // request the order form groups by main categories only — subcategories
    // fragmented "like" products and broke the alphabetical run. A product
    // tagged across several main categories appears under EACH (chosen so
    // nothing silently drops off one section of the form).
    const groups = new Map();   // mainName → [products]
    for (const p of favProducts) {
        const mains = (p.treeIds && p.treeIds.length)
            ? productMainCats(p)                       // distinct mains for this product
            : [{ id: null, name: 'Uncategorised' }];
        for (const m of mains) {
            if (!groups.has(m.name)) groups.set(m.name, []);
            groups.get(m.name).push(p);
        }
    }
    // Sort groups alphabetically, "Uncategorised" last; products by num.
    const sortedGroups = [...groups.entries()].sort((a, b) => {
        const au = a[0] === 'Uncategorised' ? 1 : 0, bu = b[0] === 'Uncategorised' ? 1 : 0;
        return au !== bu ? au - bu : a[0].localeCompare(b[0], undefined, { numeric: true });
    });
    for (const [, prods] of sortedGroups) {
        prods.sort((a, b) => String(a.num).localeCompare(String(b.num), undefined, { numeric: true }));
    }

    // Company-level header info — phone read from the company table so
    // the printed sheet identifies the seller, not just the buyer.
    let companyPhone = '';
    let companyName  = '';
    try {
        const rows = await qp(`SELECT name, phone FROM company WHERE defaultFlag = 1 LIMIT 1`);
        if (rows && rows.length) {
            companyName  = rows[0].name  || '';
            companyPhone = rows[0].phone || '';
        }
    } catch (e) {
        if (DEBUG) qoDebug('printCustomerFavourites: company lookup failed: ' + e.message, 'warn');
    }

    // Customer contact block for the sheet header — address (main office
    // / default), email + phone. Email/phone live in the `contact` table
    // (contact.datus) keyed by the customer's accountId and joined to
    // contacttype for the kind; the customer record itself has no
    // email/phone columns. Missing pieces are simply omitted.
    let custAddrLine = '';
    let custEmail = '';
    let custPhone = '';
    {
        const mainAddr = _customerAddresses.find(a => a.typeName && /main\s*office|^main$/i.test(a.typeName))
            || _customerAddresses.find(a => a.defaultFlag)
            || _customerAddresses[0];
        if (mainAddr) {
            custAddrLine = [mainAddr.street, mainAddr.city, mainAddr.state, mainAddr.zip]
                .map(x => String(x || '').trim()).filter(Boolean).join(', ');
        }
        if (_selectedCustomer.accountId != null) {
            try {
                const cRows = await qp(`
                    SELECT ct.name AS type, c.datus AS value, c.defaultFlag AS def
                    FROM contact c
                    INNER JOIN contacttype ct ON ct.id = c.typeId
                    WHERE c.accountId = ${intOf(_selectedCustomer.accountId)}
                      AND c.datus IS NOT NULL AND c.datus <> ''
                `);
                const pick = (re) => {
                    const hits = (cRows || []).filter(r => re.test(String(r.type || '')));
                    const best = hits.find(r => bitTrue(r.def)) || hits[0];
                    return best ? String(best.value).trim() : '';
                };
                custEmail = pick(/e-?mail/i);
                custPhone = pick(/phone|mobile|cell|main|work|home/i);
            } catch (e) {
                if (DEBUG) qoDebug('printCustomerFavourites: contact lookup failed: ' + e.message, 'warn');
            }
        }
    }

    // Blank date/quantity columns the sheet provides. The customer writes
    // an order date at the top of each column (the "Date:" header row),
    // then quantities down the column next to each product; the bottom
    // "Total number of items:" row has a tally box per column.
    const DATE_COLS  = 6;
    const qtyCells   = '<td class="qty"></td>'.repeat(DATE_COLS);
    const dateBoxes  = '<td class="datebox"></td>'.repeat(DATE_COLS);
    const totalBoxes = '<td class="qty tot"></td>'.repeat(DATE_COLS);
    const dateColgroup = '<col class="qty-col">'.repeat(DATE_COLS);

    // ── GROUPED body (by main category; rowspan cat cell) ─────────────
    let groupedBodyRows = '';
    for (const [mainName, prods] of sortedGroups) {
        prods.forEach((p, i) => {
            const catCell = i === 0
                ? `<td class="cat" rowspan="${prods.length}">${escapeHtml(mainName)}</td>`
                : '';
            groupedBodyRows += `<tr>${catCell}` +
                `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(p.num)}</td>` +
                `<td class="desc">${escapeHtml(p.description || '')}</td>` +
                qtyCells +
                `</tr>`;
        });
    }

    // ── FLAT body (no categories; one row per product, by num) ────────
    const flatProducts = favProducts.slice().sort((a, b) =>
        String(a.num).localeCompare(String(b.num), undefined, { numeric: true }));
    let flatBodyRows = '';
    for (const p of flatProducts) {
        flatBodyRows += `<tr>` +
            `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(p.num)}</td>` +
            `<td class="desc">${escapeHtml(p.description || '')}</td>` +
            qtyCells +
            `</tr>`;
    }

    if (!groupedBodyRows && !flatBodyRows) {
        showToast('No favourites resolved — the customer\'s favourite products may have been removed', 'info', 5000);
        return;
    }

    const totalProducts = favProducts.length;
    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Order Sheet — ${escapeHtml(_selectedCustomer.name)}</title>
<style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
        font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
        color: #000; background: #fff;
        margin: 0; padding: 12mm 12mm;
        font-size: 11pt;
    }
    /* Main header block — kept at least a business-card tall so a
       salesperson's card can be stapled / laminated to the right-hand
       side of this section. Content stays on the left. */
    .sheet-header { min-height: 55mm; }
    h1 { font-size: 22pt; margin: 0 0 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.5px; }
    h2 { font-size: 14pt; margin: 0 0 4px; font-weight: 700; }
    .contact { font-size: 10pt; color: #000; margin: 0 0 2px; }
    .instruction { font-size: 10pt; margin: 14px 0 8px; }
    .meta { font-size: 9pt; color: #444; margin: 4px 0 12px; }
    table {
        width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: 10pt; table-layout: fixed;
    }
    th, td {
        border: 1px solid #000; padding: 4px 8px;
        vertical-align: top; text-align: left;
        overflow: hidden; word-wrap: break-word;
    }
    col.cat-col { width: 12%; }
    col.num-col { width: 15%; }
    col.desc-col { width: 32%; }
    col.qty-col { width: 6.83%; }
    col.num-col-flat  { width: 20%; }
    col.desc-col-flat { width: 39%; }
    td.cat { font-weight: 700; vertical-align: middle; }
    td.num { font-weight: 600; }
    td.qty { height: 8mm; }
    /* Header row: a "Date:" prompt then one tall empty box above each
       date column for the customer to write the order date. */
    .datelabel, .totlabel { text-align: right; font-weight: 700; vertical-align: middle; }
    tr.hdr-date td.datebox { height: 12mm; }
    tr.total-row td { height: 10mm; }
    tr { page-break-inside: avoid; }
    .footer {
        margin-top: 14px; font-size: 9pt; color: #555;
        display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
    }
    @media print {
        body { padding: 8mm 8mm; }
        @page { margin: 8mm; size: portrait; }
    }
    @media screen {
        body { max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; }
        .print-bar {
            position: sticky; top: 0; background: #1e293b; color: white;
            padding: 10px 16px; margin: -12mm -12mm 0; display: flex;
            gap: 10px; align-items: center; z-index: 10;
        }
        .print-bar button {
            background: white; color: #1e293b; border: none;
            padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
        }
        .print-bar .hint { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 12px; }
        /* Show the reserved card area on screen so its size is obvious;
           it prints blank (no outline). */
        .sheet-header { outline: 1px dashed #e2e8f0; }
    }
    /* Category-mode toggle — both tables render into the page; the
       print-bar radios flip body.show-flat to choose which one shows
       (and prints). Default = grouped by main category. */
    #flatWrap { display: none; }
    body.show-flat #groupedWrap { display: none; }
    body.show-flat #flatWrap    { display: block; }
    @media screen {
        .print-bar label { color: #fff; font-size: 13px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
        .print-bar .sep { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); margin: 0 2px; }
    }
    @media print {
        .print-bar { display: none !important; }
        .sheet-header { outline: none; }
        body.show-flat #groupedWrap { display: none; }
        body:not(.show-flat) #flatWrap { display: none; }
    }
</style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="print-bar">
        <button onclick="window.print()">Print</button>
        <button onclick="window.close()" style="background:transparent;color:white;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);">Close</button>
        <span class="sep"></span>
        <label><input type="radio" name="catmode" checked onclick="document.body.classList.remove('show-flat')"> Grouped by category</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="catmode" onclick="document.body.classList.add('show-flat')"> No categories</label>
        <span class="hint">Tip: set the print destination to "Save as PDF" to download.</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sheet-header">
        <h1>${companyName ? escapeHtml(companyName) + ' ' : ''}Order Sheet</h1>
        <h2>${escapeHtml(_selectedCustomer.name)}</h2>
        ${custAddrLine ? `<div class="contact">${escapeHtml(custAddrLine)}</div>` : ''}
        ${custEmail ? `<div class="contact">${escapeHtml(custEmail)}</div>` : ''}
        ${custPhone ? `<div class="contact">${escapeHtml(custPhone)}</div>` : ''}
    </div>
    <div class="instruction">Please write the order date and the quantity required in the box next to the product before sending your order:</div>
    <div class="meta">Printed ${escapeHtml(moment().format(MOMENT_FMT))} · ${totalProducts} product${totalProducts === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>

    <!-- Grouped by main category (default). -->
    <div id="groupedWrap">
    <table>
        <colgroup>
            <col class="cat-col"><col class="num-col"><col class="desc-col">
            ${dateColgroup}
        </colgroup>
        <thead>
            <tr class="hdr-date">
                <td class="datelabel" colspan="3">Date:</td>
                ${dateBoxes}
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
            ${groupedBodyRows}
            <tr class="total-row">
                <td class="totlabel" colspan="3">Total number of items:</td>
                ${totalBoxes}
            </tr>
        </tbody>
    </table>
    </div>

    <!-- No categories (flat, one row per product). -->
    <div id="flatWrap">
    <table>
        <colgroup>
            <col class="num-col-flat"><col class="desc-col-flat">
            ${dateColgroup}
        </colgroup>
        <thead>
            <tr class="hdr-date">
                <td class="datelabel" colspan="2">Date:</td>
                ${dateBoxes}
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
            ${flatBodyRows}
            <tr class="total-row">
                <td class="totlabel" colspan="2">Total number of items:</td>
                ${totalBoxes}
            </tr>
        </tbody>
    </table>
    </div>

    <div class="footer">
        <span>Write the order date in each header box, then the quantity required next to each product.</span>
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    // Open a fresh window and write into it. JxBrowser's window.print()
    // is unreliable when called on the host page — printing from a
    // freshly-opened popup works correctly.
    const w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=1100,height=900');
    if (!w) {
        showToast('Could not open print window — check popup blocker', 'error', 5000);
        return;
    }
    try {
        w.document.open();
        w.document.write(html);
        w.document.close();
        // Give the new window a tick to layout before invoking print.
        setTimeout(() => {
            try { w.focus(); w.print(); }
            catch (e) { if (DEBUG) qoDebug('print(): ' + e.message, 'warn'); }
        }, 250);
    } catch (e) {
        showToast('Failed to render print preview: ' + e.message, 'error', 5000);
    }
}

function toggleSoDetails() {
    _soDetailsExpanded = !_soDetailsExpanded;
    applySoDetailsExpandedState();
}

function applySoDetailsExpandedState() {
    const body = document.getElementById('soDetailsBody');
    const chev = document.getElementById('soDetailsChevron');
    if (body) body.style.display = _soDetailsExpanded ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (chev) chev.style.transform = _soDetailsExpanded ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)';
}

// Compact summary shown on the collapsed-state toggle row. Mirrors the
// most useful values so the rep can verify without expanding.
function renderSoDetailsSummary() {
    const el = document.getElementById('soDetailsSummary');
    if (!el) return;
    const carrier = effectiveCarrierName() || '— no carrier —';
    const ship = _customerAddresses.find(a => a.id === _selectedShipToId);
    const shipLoc = ship ? (ship.recipient || ship.label || '') : '—';
    const po = _orderCustomerPO ? ` · PO ${_orderCustomerPO}` : '';
    el.textContent = `${carrier} · ${shipLoc}${po}`;
}

// Resolve the carrier to send in the CSV. Selected override wins; falls
// back to the customer's default, then the company default. Returns the
// NAME (which is what ImportSalesOrder's CarrierName column expects) or
// empty string if nothing is configured anywhere.
function effectiveCarrierName(cust) {
    if (_orderCarrierName) return _orderCarrierName;
    const c = cust || _selectedCustomer;
    if (c && c.carrierName) return c.carrierName;
    return _companyDefaults.carrierName || '';
}

// Same resolution chain as effectiveCarrierName(), but returning the ID for
// the REST create's carrier:{id}. Kept as a separate function rather than
// name-to-id lookup because every id is already loaded — see loadCustomers()
// (customer.carrierId) and loadCompanyDefaults() (_companyDefaults.carrierId).
//
// The company-default fallback exists in the CSV path to dodge an importer bug
// ("Unknown Carrier on line number 3" when CarrierName is blank). REST has no
// such bug and would happily default the carrier itself, but the same chain is
// kept so the order matches the carrier shown in the confirm modal.
function effectiveCarrierId(cust) {
    if (_orderCarrierId) return _orderCarrierId;
    const c = cust || _selectedCustomer;
    if (c && c.carrierId) return c.carrierId;
    return _companyDefaults.carrierId || null;
}

// ── Bootstrap ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function reloadAll() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('refreshBtn');
    if (btn) btn.style.opacity = '0.5';
    try {
        invalidatePriceCache();
        // Drop the lazy side-data caches too so stock/lead/PO refreshes.
        _partData.clear(); _inventory.clear(); _openPOs.clear();
        // Orders + their line items are caches as well.
        _orders = []; _soLines.clear(); _ordersExpanded = null;
        await loadProducts();
        migrateLegacyFavouritesIfNeeded();
        if (_selectedCustomer) {
            await loadActiveRulesForCustomer(_selectedCustomer);
            await loadCustomerPartsHistory(_selectedCustomer);
        }
        applyAllFilters();
        renderStatusLine();
        showToast(`Loaded ${_allProducts.length} products`, 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        showToast('Reload failed: ' + e.message, 'error', 6000);
        console.error(e);
    } finally {
        if (btn) btn.style.opacity = '1';
    }
}

// Reference-data + product load. Extracted from init() so submitLogin()
// can call it after a successful standalone login (init() already
// returned before the token existed). Idempotent — safe to call again
// when the rep re-connects to a different server.
async function bootstrapData() {
    // A host that bridges the legacy runApiRequest but not runRestApiAsync
    // cannot reach /api/sales-orders at all — the legacy bridge speaks only
    // ImportRq CSV envelopes. Pin the CSV route so no round trip is wasted
    // discovering that. (In portal/standalone there is no bridge either way
    // and submitSoRest() uses fetch, so this only fires on such a host.)
    if (MODE === 'fishbowl' && typeof runRestApiAsync !== 'function') {
        _soCreateRoute = 'csv';
        qoDebug('runRestApiAsync is not bridged on this host — sales orders will use the '
              + 'CSV import route.', 'warn');
    }
    try {
        // FIRST, and awaited on its own: every date rendered or submitted
        // after this point depends on it, and getting it wrong mis-dates
        // created sales orders rather than merely displaying them oddly.
        await loadDateFormat();
        await Promise.all([
            loadCustomers(),
            loadProductTrees(),
            loadLocationGroups(),
            loadUoms(),
            loadCarriers(),
            loadCompanyDefaults(),
            // Detect the customer favourites custom-field spelling for
            // this install ('Favourites' vs 'Favorites'). Fires in
            // parallel with the other reference loads — cheap, single-
            // row lookup against the `customfield` table.
            detectInstallFavouritesFieldName(),
        ]);
        await loadDefaultDispatchLg();
        updateMSTrigger('despatchLg');
        await loadProducts();
        migrateLegacyFavouritesIfNeeded();
        applyAllFilters();
        renderStatusLine();
    } catch (e) {
        showToast('Load failed: ' + e.message, 'error', 8000);
        console.error(e);
    }
}

// One-shot converter from the v1 saved state (favourites stored as
// numeric productIds) to v2 (productNums). Idempotent — only runs when
// we actually loaded a legacy block and clears the staging window var
// once done so subsequent reloads no-op.
function migrateLegacyFavouritesIfNeeded() {
    if (!Array.isArray(window._legacyFavouriteIds) || !_allProducts.length) return;
    const byId = new Map();
    for (const p of _allProducts) byId.set(p.id, p);
    for (const id of window._legacyFavouriteIds) {
        const p = byId.get(id);
        if (p && p.num) _userFavourites.add(String(p.num));
    }
    delete window._legacyFavouriteIds;
    rebuildFavouriteIdSets();
    saveState();
}

async function init() {
    if (typeof moment === 'undefined') {
        document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent = 'moment.js failed to load — check network access.';
        return;
    }
    // Mobile-UI gate. When running inside the Fishbowl desktop client
    // we always render the desktop layout regardless of viewport —
    // staff use it in the embedded JxBrowser pane and the desktop
    // layout fits/flows there. portal + standalone get the responsive
    // CSS via this body class; without it, all `body.mobile-enabled`-
    // prefixed media-query rules drop out.
    if (MODE !== 'fishbowl') document.body.classList.add('mobile-enabled');
    document.body.classList.add('mode-' + MODE);
    // Bridge detection. The iOS Fishbowl app injects bridges AFTER
    // DOMContentLoaded, so poll briefly before deciding we're standalone.
    const hasBridge = () =>
           typeof runQuery       === 'function'
        || typeof runQueryAsync  === 'function'
        || typeof runRestApiAsync === 'function';
    if (!hasBridge() && MODE !== 'standalone') {
        document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent = 'Waiting for Fishbowl bridge…';
        const start = Date.now();
        while (!hasBridge() && Date.now() - start < 5000) {
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
        }
    }

    loadCurrency();
    loadSavedState();
    // Seed the session view + cart Order-details state from the resolved
    // defaults (admin master overlaid by this user's own settings).
    applySessionDefaults();
    // Wire the debug console AFTER loadSavedState so the saved DEBUG
    // value is the one applied to panel visibility.
    initDebugConsole();
    // Show / hide the Settings admin section based on _isAdmin (set in
    // loadSavedState). Calls renderAdminLastSaved() internally so the
    // "Last published …" hint is correct on first render.
    applyAdminVisibility();

    // Apply persisted UI choices
    document.getElementById('sortBySelect').value = _sortBy;
    document.getElementById('pageSizeSelect').value = String(_pageSize);
    document.getElementById('defaultStatusIdSelect').value = String(_defaultStatusId);
    document.getElementById('t2ModuleOptSelect').value = _t2ModuleOpt;
    document.getElementById('t3ModuleOptSelect').value = _t3ModuleOpt;
    document.getElementById('lazyImagesToggle').checked = _lazyImages;
    document.getElementById('autoOpenSoToggle').checked = _autoOpenSo;
    const showDebugEl = document.getElementById('showDebugToggle');
    if (showDebugEl) showDebugEl.checked = DEBUG;
    const gbpEl = document.getElementById('groupByPartToggle');
    if (gbpEl) gbpEl.checked = !!_groupByPart;
    const gpuEl = document.getElementById('groupPreferredUomInput');
    if (gpuEl) gpuEl.value = _groupPreferredUOM || 'ea';
    const fwpEl = document.getElementById('favouriteWholePartToggle');
    if (fwpEl) fwpEl.checked = !!_favouriteWholePart;
    const sopEl = document.getElementById('showOrigPriceToggle');
    if (sopEl) sopEl.checked = !!_showOrigPrice;
    const supEl = document.getElementById('showUpcTileToggle');
    if (supEl) supEl.checked = !!_showUpcTile;
    const fdmEl = document.getElementById('favDisplayModeSelect');
    if (fdmEl) fdmEl.value = _favDisplayMode;
    const acfEl = document.getElementById('autoCreateFavCfToggle');
    if (acfEl) acfEl.checked = !!_autoCreateFavCf;
    const dvmEl = document.getElementById('defaultViewModeSelect');
    if (dvmEl) dvmEl.value = _defaultViewMode;
    const dsdEl = document.getElementById('defaultSoDetailsExpandedToggle');
    if (dsdEl) dsdEl.checked = !!_defaultSoDetailsExpanded;
    updatePrintFavBtnVisibility();
    document.getElementById('searchInput').value = _filters.search || '';
    updatePrevPurchasedBtn();
    updateFavouritesBtn();
    updateInStockOnlyBtn();
    updateGroupByTreeBtn();
    setViewMode(_viewMode);

    buildMS('cust');
    buildMS('tree');
    buildMS('lg');
    buildMS('despatchLg');

    document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', debounce(() => applyAllFilters(), 250));

    // Orders view wiring. Search is client-side over the already-fetched
    // array — see loadOrders() for why no free text reaches SQL.
    const ordSearch = document.getElementById('ordersSearchInput');
    if (ordSearch) {
        ordSearch.addEventListener('input', debounce(e => {
            _ordersSearch = e.target.value || '';
            applyOrdersSearch();
        }, 250));
    }
    // Applies the saved layout preference, reveals the tablet override button
    // if this is a tablet, and registers the tier-flip listener so dragging a
    // desktop window across 1024px doesn't leave a table where cards belong.
    // That listener is scoped to the orders view on purpose — the catalogue's
    // render path is left alone so this cannot regress it.
    applyLayoutPref();

    document.getElementById('lazyImagesToggle').addEventListener('change', e => {
        _lazyImages = e.target.checked;
        saveState();
        renderProducts();
    });
    document.getElementById('autoOpenSoToggle').addEventListener('change', e => {
        _autoOpenSo = e.target.checked;
        saveState();
    });
    if (showDebugEl) showDebugEl.addEventListener('change', e => {
        DEBUG = e.target.checked;
        applyDebugVisibility();
        saveState();
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
        // The mobile customer trigger (in the header) and the Orders
        // toolbar's customer button are logically part of the cust
        // ms-container even though they live elsewhere in the DOM.
        // Without these exclusions, tapping one opens the dropdown AND
        // then the bubbled click closes it again in the same tick.
        if (!e.target.closest('.ms-container, #mobileCustomerTrigger')) closeMS();
        // Same for the orders filter popover — a click on its own button is
        // handled by openOrdersMenu's toggle, so exclude both.
        if (!e.target.closest('#ordersMenu, #ordersToolbar .ot-pill')) closeOrdersMenu();
        // Close the list-column selector when clicking anywhere outside it.
        if (!e.target.closest('#colWrap')) {
            const cp = document.getElementById('colPanel');
            if (cp) cp.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    });

    // Order-note modal — char counter + keyboard shortcuts.
    const noteTa = document.getElementById('qoOrderNoteTextarea');
    if (noteTa) {
        noteTa.addEventListener('input', updateOrderNoteCount);
        noteTa.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape')                         { e.preventDefault(); closeOrderNoteModal(); }
            else if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) { e.preventDefault(); saveOrderNote(); }
        });
    }

    // Standalone mode — show the connect pill, prompt for login if no
    // token yet, otherwise proceed with the data load using the cached
    // token. The header pill stays available so reps can re-auth or
    // switch servers without reloading.
    // Portal mode — fetch identity + FB binding status. If the user
    // hasn't connected a Fishbowl account yet, loadPortalIdentity will
    // open the connect modal and bootstrapData is deferred until that
    // succeeds (submitFbConnect calls bootstrapData on success).
    updateConnPill();
    if (MODE === 'portal') {
        enableIdleTimer();
        const ok = await loadPortalIdentity();
        if (ok === false) return;   // connect modal is open; wait for user
        // Pre-warm the Worker's DO token. Fire-and-forget — the Worker
        // checks KV → DO → FB login behind the scenes so the first real
        // user action (load customers, add to cart) hits a warm token
        // and skips the ~300ms cold-start FB login. The SELECT 1 is
        // also the cheapest possible probe of the full chain (Function
        // → Worker → DO → tunnel → FB), so a failure here surfaces the
        // server-status pill before the user clicks anything.
        fetch('/api/data-query?query=' + encodeURIComponent('SELECT 1 AS warmup'),
              { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })
            .then(r => { if (r.ok) noteServerOk(); else if (r.status >= 500) noteServerError(); })
            .catch(() => noteServerError());
    }
    if (MODE === 'standalone' && !_conn.token) {
        document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent =
            'Standalone mode — click Connect to log in to Fishbowl.';
        document.getElementById('productHost').innerHTML =
            '<div style="background:white;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;padding:20px;margin:12px;max-width:560px;">'
          + '<h2 style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;margin:0 0 8px;">Not connected to Fishbowl</h2>'
          + '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#475569;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 12px;">'
          + 'This report is running outside the Fishbowl desktop client, so it needs to authenticate '
          + 'against your Fishbowl server. Click <strong>Connect…</strong> in the header to log in.'
          + '</p>'
          + '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;line-height:1.5;margin:0;">'
          + 'You must first register this app in <em>Fishbowl → Maintenance → Integrated Applications</em> '
          + 'and have an admin approve it. Once connected, your credentials persist on this device until you log out.'
          + '</p></div>';
        openConnModal();
        return;
    }

    bootstrapData();
}

function debounce(fn, ms) {
    let t = null;
    return (...args) => {
        clearTimeout(t);
        t = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), ms);
    };
}

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
</script>
